items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: О҆рꙋ́жїа ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ, посѣка́ющїе тмы̀ бл҃же́ннїи де́монѡвъ блгⷣтїю. и҆ ны́нѣ тма́мъ совокꙋпи́стесѧ ра́дꙋющесѧ, мы́сленныхъ си́лъ.
items.english_text: of idol madness, O martyr Agapius, by the streams of thy blood; therefore do we praise thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: of idol madness, O martyr Agapius, by the streams of thy blood; therefore do we praise thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋ́ть соверши́вше мꙋче́нїа мꙋ́жески, ѿложе́нїемъ тѣ́ла, вы́шнее постиго́сте црⷭ҇тво: въ не́мже стѧжа́сте мꙋ́нцы бж҃твеннїи житїѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye were revealed as weapons cutting down the darkness of the demons by grace, O blessed ones; and now rejoicing ye have joined myriads of the noetic powers.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Ye were revealed as weapons cutting down the darkness of the demons by grace, O blessed ones; and now rejoicing ye have joined myriads of the noetic powers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пло́тїемъ пло́ти ꙗ҆вльшагосѧ, и҆з̾ твоегѡ̀ свѣтоно́снагѡ чре́ва, зижди́телѧ позна́хомъ, за млⷭ҇рдїе ма́ти, на́мъ пою́щымъ тѧ̀, мт҃и приснодв҃о.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having accomplished the course of martyrdom courageously, by the putting off of the body ye reached the kingdom on high, wherein ye acquired divine life, O martyrs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having accomplished the course of martyrdom courageously, by the putting off of the body ye reached the kingdom on high, wherein ye acquired divine life, O martyrs.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Воскр҃се: Седмочи́сленный ли́къ ст҃ы́хъ мꙋ́никъ, пострада̀ крѣ́пкѡ за бж҃твеннꙋю трⷪ҇цꙋ. погꙋбѝ мно́жества мы́сленныхъ врагѡ́въ, блгⷣтїю: и҆ совокꙋпи́шасѧ тма́мъ нбⷭ҇ныхъ ᲂу҆мѡ́въ дх҃омъ. тѣ́хъ моли́твами ᲂу҆ще́дри на́съ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We know the Creator, Who through tender mercy appeared in bodily flesh from thy light-bearing womb, O Mother, as we hymn thee, O Mother, Ever-Virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
We know the Creator, Who through tender mercy appeared in bodily flesh from thy light-bearing womb, O Mother, as we hymn thee, O Mother, Ever-Virgin.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Всѧ́кагѡ преще́нїѧ и҆ ѕло́бы чл҃вѣческїѧ, спасѝ на́съ прест҃а́ѧ дв҃о: та́ бо и҆́мамы покро́въ и҆ застꙋпле́нїе, прибѣга́ющїи къ тебѣ̀ бг҃ома́ти, и҆ рожде́нномꙋ и҆з̾ тебѐ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ: є҆го́же молѝ, и҆зба́вити на́съ бѣ́дъ и҆ скорбе́й.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Christ is risen" (Воскр҃се):* The sevenfold choir of holy martyrs suffered valiantly for the divine Trinity; by grace they destroyed the multitudes of noetic foes, and in spirit were united with myriads of heavenly minds: by their prayers have mercy on us, O Lover of mankind.[^244]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Christ is risen" (Воскр҃се):*
The sevenfold choir of holy martyrs suffered valiantly for the divine Trinity; by grace they destroyed the multitudes of noetic foes, and in spirit were united with myriads of heavenly minds: by their prayers have mercy on us, O Lover of mankind.[^244]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. і҆рмо́съ: И҆з̾ горы̀ приѡсѣне́нныѧ сло́ве, проро́къ, є҆ди́ныѧ бцы̀, хотѧ́ща воплоти́тисѧ, бг҃ови́днѡ ᲂу҆смотрѝ, и҆ со стра́хомъ славосло́вѧше си́лꙋ твою̀.
items.english_text: From every threat and human malice save us, O all-holy Virgin: for we who flee unto thee, O Mother of God, and unto our God Who was born of thee, have thee as protection and intercession: pray Thou Him to deliver us from tribulations and sorrows.

provenance.verbatim_source: From every threat and human malice save us, O all-holy Virgin: for we who flee unto thee, O Mother of God, and unto our God Who was born of thee, have thee as protection and intercession: pray Thou Him to deliver us from tribulations and sorrows.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆сла́ми хрⷭ҇та а҆га́пїе возлю́бль, страсте́мъ тогѡ̀ мꙋ́жески ᲂу҆подо́билсѧ є҆сѝ. заколе́нъ бы́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнецъ во́лею, великомꙋ́чениче досточꙋ́дне.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The spotless Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb and Shepherd upon the Cross, cried out: My Child, what is this strange and unexpected sight? How is the Life of all condemned to death like mortals? But arise on the third day from the dead, O Word, even as Thou didst say, that rejoicing I may glorify Thee![^245]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
The spotless Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb and Shepherd upon the Cross, cried out: My Child, what is this strange and unexpected sight? How is the Life of all condemned to death like mortals? But arise on the third day from the dead, O Word, even as Thou didst say, that rejoicing I may glorify Thee![^245]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Мечꙋ̀ себе́са́ми вда́вше, всемꙋ́дреннїи мꙋ́ченицы мꙋ́дрїи: кропле́нїи крове́й ѡ҆багри́сте ри̑зы, въ ню́же ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвшесѧ на нб҃сѣ́хъ живе́те.
items.english_text: *Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:* From the overshadowing mountain, O Word, from the only Birthgiver of God, the prophet with divine vision perceived Thee Who wast about to become incarnate, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^246]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
From the overshadowing mountain, O Word, from the only Birthgiver of God, the prophet with divine vision perceived Thee Who wast about to become incarnate, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^246]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́шаѧ къ бг҃ꙋ те́плаѧ любѡ́вь! є҆ѧ́же ра́ди себе́самы́хъ ѿверго́стесѧ до конца̀: и҆ но́жнѣйшꙋю сме́рть поде́мше, безсме́ртїѧ сподо́бистесѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having loved the commandments of Christ, O Agapius, thou wast manfully conformed unto His sufferings, being slain willingly like a lamb, O praiseworthy great-martyr.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having loved the commandments of Christ, O Agapius, thou wast manfully conformed unto His sufferings, being slain willingly like a lamb, O praiseworthy great-martyr.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тро́бою чре́вѣ сло́ва прїѧ́ла є҆сѝ нескве́рнаѧ чи́стаѧ, ве́сь мі́ръ ѿ ѕлодѣ́йствїѧ ѡ҆чи́стившаго, всѧ́кихъ согрѣше́нїй. тѣ́мъ вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Surrendering yourselves unto the sword, O all-wise and prudent martyrs, with the sprinkling of blood ye dyed your garments, clothed in which ye dwell in the heavens.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Surrendering yourselves unto the sword, O all-wise and prudent martyrs, with the sprinkling of blood ye dyed your garments, clothed in which ye dwell in the heavens.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тро́бою чре́вѣ сло́ва прїѧ́ла є҆сѝ нескве́рнаѧ чи́стаѧ, ве́сь мі́ръ ѿ ѕлодѣ́йствїѧ ѡ҆чи́стившаго, всѧ́кихъ согрѣше́нїй. тѣ́мъ вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Warm was your love toward God! For its sake ye denied yourselves utterly, and enduring death by the sword, ye were accounted worthy of immortality.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Warm was your love toward God! For its sake ye denied yourselves utterly, and enduring death by the sword, ye were accounted worthy of immortality.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тро́бою чре́вѣ сло́ва прїѧ́ла є҆сѝ нескве́рнаѧ чи́стаѧ, ве́сь мі́ръ ѿ ѕлодѣ́йствїѧ ѡ҆чи́стившаго, всѧ́кихъ согрѣше́нїй. тѣ́мъ вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In thy womb thou didst receive the Word, O undefiled and pure one, Who cleansed the whole world from every transgression of wrongdoing; therefore we faithfully bless thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
In thy womb thou didst receive the Word, O undefiled and pure one, Who cleansed the whole world from every transgression of wrongdoing; therefore we faithfully bless thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Любо́венъ дѣѧ́нїемъ, ꙗ҆́коже и҆ зва́нїемъ бы́въ сла́вне, пострада́лъ є҆сѝ за любо́вь всецр҃ѧ̀ хрⷭ҇та бг҃а на́шегѡ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Thou Who from the night of ignorance didst enlighten the ends of the earth by the knowledge of God, enlighten me by the dawn of Thy love for mankind, O Lord.[^247]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Thou Who from the night of ignorance didst enlighten the ends of the earth by the knowledge of God, enlighten me by the dawn of Thy love for mankind, O Lord.[^247]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Глаго́лъ лю́тагѡ мꙋчи́телѧ попра́сте, ст҃і́и мꙋ́ченницы, и҆ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ с҆воинни́вшесѧ, полкѝ де́мѡнскїѧ погꙋби́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Loving in deed as also in name, O glorious one, thou didst suffer for love of Christ our God, the King of all.[^248]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Loving in deed as also in name, O glorious one, thou didst suffer for love of Christ our God, the King of all.[^248]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нными по́двиги низлага́юще беззако́нныхъ де́рзость: вѣнце́мъ безсме́ртїа, мꙋ́ченницы хрⷭ҇товы ᲂу҆вѧзо́стесѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The decree of the fierce tormentor ye trampled down, O holy martyrs, and enlisting yourselves under Christ, ye destroyed the ranks of demons.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The decree of the fierce tormentor ye trampled down, O holy martyrs, and enlisting yourselves under Christ, ye destroyed the ranks of demons.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пѣсносло́вїи бж҃е́ственными, бцⷣꙋ вѣ́рнїи ᲂу҆бл҃жи́мъ: ра́дꙋйсѧ, гл҃юще, две́рь, є҆́юже є҆ди́нъ про́йде гдⷭ҇ь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By sacred contests casting down the audacity of the lawless, with the crown of immortality were ye encircled, O martyrs of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By sacred contests casting down the audacity of the lawless, with the crown of immortality were ye encircled, O martyrs of Christ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ сп҃се, мнѡ́га бо беззакѡ́нїа моѧ̑, и҆ и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ ѕѡ́лъ возведѝ молю́сѧ, къ тебѣ́ бо возопи́хъ, и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ши мѧ̀ бж҃е сп҃се́нїѧ моегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With divine hymns let us the faithful bless the Birthgiver of God, crying: Rejoice, O Gate through which the Lord alone passed![^249]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With divine hymns let us the faithful bless the Birthgiver of God, crying: Rejoice, O Gate through which the Lord alone passed![^249]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Со а҆леѯа́ндрома двѣма̀, дїонѵ́сїа два̀ воспои́мъ: а҆га́пїа сла́внаго, тїмола́а и҆ рѡмѵ́ла, крѣ́пкѡ пострада́вшыѧ, и҆ тмы̑ вра́жїѧ поразова́вшыѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities, and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and do Thou give ear unto me, O God of my salvation.[^250]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities, and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and do Thou give ear unto me, O God of my salvation.[^250]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́нїй рѣ́ки и҆сточа́юще мꙋ́ченицы, стра̑сти земноро́дныхъ бж҃твеннѣ ᲂу҆чаща́ете. сегѡ̀ ра́ди ра́дꙋющесѧ, ва́ша вѣ́рою восхвалѧ́емъ до́блести.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With two Alexanders, let us hymn two Dionysiuses, the glorious Agapius, Timolaus and Romulus, who suffered valiantly and vanquished the enemy's hordes.[^251]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With two Alexanders, let us hymn two Dionysiuses, the glorious Agapius, Timolaus and Romulus, who suffered valiantly and vanquished the enemy's hordes.[^251]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Зако́ннѡ, сщ҃енный по́двигъ соверши́вше, зако́ннѡ вседѣ́тельною дла́нїю вѣнча́стесѧ, седмочи́сленнїи мꙋ́нцы, нбⷭ҇нїи гра́ждане, а҆́гглѡмъ равностоѧ́телїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pouring forth rivers of healings, O martyrs, ye divinely relieve the passions of mortals; on this account, rejoicing in faith, we praise your valiant deeds.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Pouring forth rivers of healings, O martyrs, ye divinely relieve the passions of mortals; on this account, rejoicing in faith, we praise your valiant deeds.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆вѧди́вшаѧ сады̑ безбо́жїа, всенепоро́чнаѧ твои́мъ ст҃ы́мъ прозѧбе́нїемъ: прозѧба́ющꙋю во мнѣ̀ бы́въ вра́жїю ѕло́бꙋ и҆скоренѝ бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having lawfully accomplished the sacred contest, lawfully were ye crowned by the all-working Palm, O sevenfold martyrs, heavenly citizens, equals of the angels.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having lawfully accomplished the sacred contest, lawfully were ye crowned by the all-working Palm, O sevenfold martyrs, heavenly citizens, equals of the angels.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѿ і҆ꙋде́и доше́дше ѻ҆́троцы, въ вавѷлѡ́нѣ и҆ногда̀, вѣ́рою трⷪ҇ческою пла́мень пе́щный попра́ша пою́ще: ѻ҆ц҃є́въ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-immaculate Bride of God, who by thy holy Offspring didst wither the groves of godlessness: uproot the enemy's malice that sprouts within me.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O all-immaculate Bride of God, who by thy holy Offspring didst wither the groves of godlessness: uproot the enemy's malice that sprouts within me.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Са́ми себѐ во́льнѡ къ заколе́нїю ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнцы преда́сте, не ᲂу҆боѧ́вшесѧ мꙋ́къ всехва́льнїи ѻ҆рꙋ́жницы: но бл҃годꙋ́шнѡ взыва́юще: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7, Tone 8. Heirmos:* The youths who went down from Judea to Babylon of old trampled underfoot the flame of the furnace by faith in the Trinity, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^252]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣ́щсѧ любо́вїю всѣ́хъ влⷣки, мꙋ́чениче а҆га́пїе, подклони́лъ є҆сѝ вы́ю мечꙋ̀: и҆ мꙋ́ченикѡвъ сꙋчи́слилсѧ є҆сѝ во́инствꙋ, взыва́ѧ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Willingly did ye surrender yourselves unto slaughter like lambs, fearing not torments, O all-praised warriors, but crying with good courage: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Willingly did ye surrender yourselves unto slaughter like lambs, fearing not torments, O all-praised warriors, but crying with good courage: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́лникъ зри́тесѧ въ домꙋ̀ гдⷭ҇ни мꙋ́ченицы сла́вні́и седмостебе́ленный, мі́ръ просвѣща́ющїй, вопїю́ще, сїѧ́нїемъ блгⷣти: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Illumined with love for the Master of all, O martyr Agapius, thou didst bow thy neck unto the sword, and wast numbered among the army of martyrs, crying: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Illumined with love for the Master of all, O martyr Agapius, thou didst bow thy neck unto the sword, and wast numbered among the army of martyrs, crying: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a seven-branched lamp are ye seen in the house of the Lord, O glorious martyrs, enlightening the world, crying aloud in the radiance of grace: O God of our fathers,

provenance.verbatim_source:

As a seven-branched lamp are ye seen in the house of the Lord, O glorious martyrs, enlightening the world, crying aloud in the radiance of grace: O God of our fathers,

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҆. і҆рмо́съ: На горѣ̀ ст҃ѣ́й просла́вльшасѧ, и҆ въ кꙋпинѣ̀ ѻ҆гне́мъ приснодв҃ы мѡѷсе́ови та́йнꙋ ꙗ҆́вльшаго, гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Loose me who am bound with the cords of ineffable transgressions, O all-immaculate one, granting me a shower of tears as I sing unto Him Who shone forth from thee: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Loose me who am bound with the cords of ineffable transgressions, O all-immaculate one, granting me a shower of tears as I sing unto Him Who shone forth from thee: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Вра́чеве разли́чныхъ недꙋ́гѡвъ, рꙋкодѣ́йствомъ дх҃а показа́вшесѧ, всѧ̑ на́ша недꙋ́ги и҆сцѣли́те: ꙗ҆́кѡ да восхвалѧ́емъ и҆ славосло́вимъ ва́шꙋ бж҃е́ственнꙋю па́мѧть.
items.english_text: *Ode 8, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who was glorified on the holy mountain, and in the bush revealed unto Moses by fire the mystery of the Ever-Virgin, sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^253]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Unto Him Who was glorified on the holy mountain, and in the bush revealed unto Moses by fire the mystery of the Ever-Virgin, sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^253]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ бг҃а, ѿ тогѡ́ мꙋ́нче возлюби́лсѧ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ по́двигъ бж҃е́ственный соверши́вша, приведѐ со є҆динноревни́тели, въ нбⷭ҇ныѧ а҆га́пїе черто́ги.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Revealed by the working of the Spirit as physicians of diverse diseases, heal all our infirmities, that we may praise and glorify your divine memory.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Revealed by the working of the Spirit as physicians of diverse diseases, heal all our infirmities, that we may praise and glorify your divine memory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆крѣ́пльшасѧ любо́вїю влⷣки, наси́лованїе низложи́сте преле́стника, и҆ бл҃госла́внѡ побѣ́дами ᲂу҆краша́еми, въ небе́сныхъ мꙋ́ченицы гдⷭ҇ни живе́те поко́ищахъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst love God, and by Him, O martyr, wast thou loved; therefore, having accomplished the divine contest, He led thee with thy fellow-zealots into the heavenly bridal chambers, O Agapius.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst love God, and by Him, O martyr, wast thou loved; therefore, having accomplished the divine contest, He led thee with thy fellow-zealots into the heavenly bridal chambers, O Agapius.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Исцѣлѝ стра̑сти срⷣца моегѡ̀, безстра́стїѧ и҆сто́чника ро́ждшаѧ, и҆ къ живо́тꙋ мѧ̀ бж҃е́ственномꙋ наста́ви, да тѧ̀ сла́влю мт҃рь сп҃совꙋ, во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthened by love for the Master, ye cast down the violence of the deceiver, and adorned with glorious victories, ye dwell in heavenly resting places, O martyrs of the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Strengthened by love for the Master, ye cast down the violence of the deceiver, and adorned with glorious victories, ye dwell in heavenly resting places, O martyrs of the Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Вои́стиннꙋ бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ и҆сповѣ́дꙋемъ, спасе́нїи тобо́ю дв҃о чⷭ҇таѧ, съ безпло́тными ли́ки тѧ̀ велича́юще.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal the passions of my heart, O thou who didst bring forth the Well-spring of dispassion, and guide me unto divine life, that I may glorify thee, the Mother of the Savior, unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Heal the passions of my heart, O thou who didst bring forth the Well-spring of dispassion, and guide me unto divine life, that I may glorify thee, the Mother of the Savior, unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Кра̑сни бы́вше, бж҃е́ственными бл҃голѣ́потами мꙋче́нїѧ, гдⷭ҇ви предстоитѐ: и҆ съ ни́мъ страстоте́рпцы при́снѡ весели́тесѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Truly do we confess thee to be the Birthgiver of God, who through thee have been saved, O pure Virgin, magnifying thee with the bodiless choirs.[^254]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Truly do we confess thee to be the Birthgiver of God, who through thee have been saved, O pure Virgin, magnifying thee with the bodiless choirs.[^254]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Во́инство а҆́гглское ва́съ прїе́млетъ, распрѧ́гшыѧсѧ тѣ́ла мꙋ́ченицы, къ не́номꙋ гра́дꙋ, къ свѣ́тꙋ невече́рнемꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become beautiful with the divine comeliness of martyrdom, ye stand before the Lord, and with Him, O passion-bearers, ye ever rejoice.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become beautiful with the divine comeliness of martyrdom, ye stand before the Lord, and with Him, O passion-bearers, ye ever rejoice.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: На́съ соверша́ющихъ дне́сь па́мѧть сщ҃еннꙋю ва́шꙋ, мꙋ́ченицы сла́вні́и, къ бг҃ꙋ помнꙋ́ти не преста́ните.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The angelic host receives you, O martyrs, who have been loosed from the body, leading you unto the heavenly city, unto the unwaning Light.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The angelic host receives you, O martyrs, who have been loosed from the body, leading you unto the heavenly city, unto the unwaning Light.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣ́томъ мѧ̀ покаѧ́нїа, помраче́ннаго небреже́нїемъ, всенепоро́чнаѧ просвѣтѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою̀ и҆ сла́влю вели́чїа твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Cease not to remember before God us who today celebrate your sacred memory, O glorious martyrs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Cease not to remember before God us who today celebrate your sacred memory, O glorious martyrs.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 15th Day: The Holy Martyr Agapius and with him Six Martyrs*[^239]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣ́томъ мѧ̀ покаѧ́нїа, помраче́ннаго небреже́нїемъ, всенепоро́чнаѧ просвѣтѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою̀ и҆ сла́влю вели́чїа твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With the light of repentance enlighten me who am darkened through negligence, O all-immaculate one, that I may hymn and glorify thy majesty.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With the light of repentance enlighten me who am darkened through negligence, O all-immaculate one, that I may hymn and glorify thy majesty.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Что́ тѧ ны́нѣ саві́не пронарече́мъ? * рѣкꙋ̀ воды̀ живо́тныѧ лїю́щꙋ на́мъ широтꙋ̀ дх҃о́внꙋю, * ᲂу҆тѣсне́ннымъ въ люты́хъ: * наводне́нїе и҆сцѣле́нїй неизжива́емое: * ча́шꙋ, пиво̀ ст҃о́е пролива́ющꙋю: * чꙋдодѣ́телѧ и҆́стиннѣйша: * безпло́тныхъ равноче́стнаго. * молѝ спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ на дре́вѣ просте́рта во́лею крⷭ҇тне́мъ, * вопїѧ́ше ма́терски, * болѣ́знꙋющи съ пла́чемъ: * сн҃е мо́й, что̀ стра́нное сїѐ видѣ́нїе, * всѣ̑мъ живо́тъ даѧ́й ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь? * ка́кѡ ᲂу҆мерщвлѧ́ешисѧ долготерпѣли́ве, * земны̑мъ подаѧ̀ воскрⷭ҇нїе? * сла́влю твоѐ мно́гое бж҃е мо́й снизхожде́нїе.
items.english_text: What shall we name thee, O glorious one? A valiant soldier of the King and God, who manfully cast down the impiety of the bodiless spirits; a lamp shining with noetic light; an all-powerful destroyer of idols; a most fervent ascetic and most lawful sufferer: pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: What shall we name thee, O glorious one? A valiant soldier of the King and God, who manfully cast down the impiety of the bodiless spirits; a lamp shining with noetic light; an all-powerful destroyer of idols; a most fervent ascetic and most lawful sufferer: pray that our souls may be saved.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Страда́льчески саві́на восхвалю̀
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Страда́льчески саві́на восхвалю̀ любо́вїю. Кѵ́ръ ѳеофа́на. Гла́съ, и҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. і҆рмо́съ: Во́дꙋ проше́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ є҆гѵ́петскагѡ ѕла̀ и҆збѣжа́въ, і҆изра́ильтѧнинъ вопїѧ́ше, и҆зба́вителю и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пои́мъ.
items.english_text: What shall we now proclaim thee, O Sabinus? A river of living water pouring forth unto us spiritual breadth, when we are hemmed in by misfortunes; an inexhaustible inundation of healings; a cup pouring forth a holy draught; a most true wonderworker, an equal in honor of the bodiless spirits: pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: What shall we now proclaim thee, O Sabinus? A river of living water pouring forth unto us spiritual breadth, when we are hemmed in by misfortunes; an inexhaustible inundation of healings; a cup pouring forth a holy draught; a most true wonderworker, an equal in honor of the bodiless spirits: pray that our souls may be saved.

items.english_text: What shall we declare thee, O holy one? A guide of the wandering, or an intercessor for sinners; a true physician for them that are storm-tossed in misfortunes; a precious sweet-smelling lily of paradise; a first-fruit and confirmation of martyrs; an ever-flowing fountain of miracles, a valiant ascetic: pray that our souls may be saved.

items.english_text: Unto what hast thou likened thyself, O wretched soul, looking not up at all unto repentance, and fearing not the fire that awaits the wicked? Arise, and call upon her who alone is swift to intercede, and cry aloud: O Virgin Mother, pray Thy Son and our God to deliver me from the snare of the deceiver.

items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, Tone 8, Podoben: "What shall we call you, O holy ones" (Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ):* When the Ewe-lamb beheld the Lamb stretched out willingly upon the tree of the Cross, maternal-like she cried aloud, in agony with weeping: My Son, what is this strange sight, Thou Who givest life unto all as Lord? How art Thou put to death, O Long-suffering One, granting resurrection unto mortals? I glorify Thy great condescension, O my God![^256]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Страда́льчески саві́на восхвалю̀ любо́вїю. Кѵ́ръ ѳеофа́на. Гла́съ, и҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. і҆рмо́съ: Во́дꙋ проше́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ є҆гѵ́петскагѡ ѕла̀ и҆збѣжа́въ, і҆изра́ильтѧнинъ вопїѧ́ше, и҆зба́вителю и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пои́мъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Having traversed the water as dry land, and having escaped the malice of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^258]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Having traversed the water as dry land, and having escaped the malice of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^258]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Же́ртвꙋ хвале́нїѧ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ себѐ ѡ҆́брѣтъ, къ страда́нїемъ терпѣли́внѡ, въ пꙋсты́нѧхъ ᲂу҆дали́лсѧ є҆сѝ саві́не, по́стническими ѡ҆бꙋча́ѧсѧ по́двиги.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Delighting now in uncorrupt and divine dwelling and incomprehensible good things, O Sabinus, with the martyrs, O God-wise one, save them that praise Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Delighting now in uncorrupt and divine dwelling and incomprehensible good things, O Sabinus, with the martyrs, O God-wise one, save them that praise Thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Цвѣтцы̀ наслади́всѧ дх҃о́вными, ра́й ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆кра́шенъ добродѣ́телми, ѡ҆б̾е́млемь мече́мъ мꙋче́нїа, и҆ снѣ́дь бг҃ꙋ познава́емь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having found thyself a sacrifice of praise unto Christ, patiently unto sufferings, in deserts didst thou dwell afar off, O Sabinus, exercising thyself in ascetical labors.[^259]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having found thyself a sacrifice of praise unto Christ, patiently unto sufferings, in deserts didst thou dwell afar off, O Sabinus, exercising thyself in ascetical labors.[^259]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѽбе́же сме́ртное сѣ́тованїе: живо́тъ бо и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀, во ѵ҆поста́си бг҃ъ про́йде несказа́ннѡ бцⷣе, ѡ҆бновлѧ́ѧй дв҃о є҆стество̀ на́ше.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Delighting in spiritual flowers, a paradise adorned with virtues wast thou revealed, surrounded by the sword of martyrdom and recognized as food for God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Delighting in spiritual flowers, a paradise adorned with virtues wast thou revealed, surrounded by the sword of martyrdom and recognized as food for God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ты̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дх҃ъ мо́й.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mortal lamentation hath fled away; for Life, God in hypostasis, ineffably proceeded from thy womb, O Birthgiver of God, renewing our nature, O Virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Mortal lamentation hath fled away; for Life, God in hypostasis, ineffably proceeded from thy womb, O Birthgiver of God, renewing our nature, O Virgin.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ содѣ́лавъ чи́стою твою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ въ ню̀ бг҃а, и҆ хра́мы де́монскїѧ, ѽ саві́не низложи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee.[^260]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee.[^260]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Млати́ва, ра́ди мл҃ти бг҃а ѡ҆́брѣтъ, страсте́мъ є҆гѡ̀ подража́тель бы́лъ є҆сѝ, преда́телю ᲂу҆чени́кꙋ бывшꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having made thy pure soul a temple, thou didst receive God into it, and didst cast down demonic temples, O Sabinus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having made thy pure soul a temple, thou didst receive God into it, and didst cast down demonic temples, O Sabinus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бг҃а ро́ждши, всеѧ̀ тва́ри бл҃гꙋю, ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ є҆ди́на бцⷣа, превы́шшаѧ ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Finding God to be merciful for mercy's sake, an imitator of His sufferings becamest thou, when a disciple became a betrayer.[^261]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Finding God to be merciful for mercy's sake, an imitator of His sufferings becamest thou, when a disciple became a betrayer.[^261]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Оу҆ѧзви́всѧ любо́вїю и҆зба́вителѧ, ꙗ҆́звы многообра́зны и҆ растерза́нїа претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ свѧ́те, мꙋ́жественнымъ мꙋдрова́нїемъ: въ рѣкꙋ́ же вве́рженъ бы́въ, коне́цъ ст҃ы́и въ не́й прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ. и҆ бога́тство многоцѣ́нно всѣ́мъ пода́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆сточа́ѧ и҆сцѣле́нїѧ, и҆ рѣша́ѧ недꙋ́ги вѣ́рнѡ притека́ющымъ къ тебѣ̀ саві́не блаже́нне. молѝ хрⷭ҇та бг҃а, прегрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, чтꙋ́щымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth to God, the good of all creation, as truly the only Birthgiver of God, thou wast revealed higher than all.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having given birth to God, the good of all creation, as truly the only Birthgiver of God, thou wast revealed higher than all.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃ꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, всѝ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ ро́ди человѣ́честїи: ѻ҆́гнь бо всели́сѧ въ тѧ̀ бж҃тва̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ младе́нца млеко́мъ пита́еши зижди́телѧ и҆ гдⷭ҇а. тѣ́мъ а҆́гглскїй и҆ человѣ́ческїй ро́дъ, досто́йнѡ сла́вимъ прⷭ҇тое рж҃тво̀ твоѐ, и҆ согла́снѡ вопїе́мъ тѝ: молѝ хрⷭ҇та бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, покланѧ́ющымсѧ вѣ́рою престо́мꙋ рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Guiding unto wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):* Wounded with love for the Deliverer, diverse wounds and lacerations didst thou endure, O holy one, with manly mind; and cast into the river, a holy end didst thou receive therein; and costly riches wast thou given unto all, pouring forth healings and loosing diseases for them that faithfully flee unto thee, O blessed Sabinus: pray Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor thy holy memory with love.[^262]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Guiding unto wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):*
Wounded with love for the Deliverer, diverse wounds and lacerations didst thou endure, O holy one, with manly mind; and cast into the river, a holy end didst thou receive therein; and costly riches wast thou given unto all, pouring forth healings and loosing diseases for them that faithfully flee unto thee, O blessed Sabinus: pray Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor thy holy memory with love.[^262]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, восклица́ше пла́чꙋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ
items.english_text: As a virgin and only one among women, who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all generations of men bless thee: for the fire of the Godhead took up His abode in thee, and as an infant thou didst feed with milk the Creator and Lord; therefore both the angelic and the human race worthily glorify thy most holy nativity, and in unison we cry unto thee: Pray Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that worship thy most holy nativity with faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: As a virgin and only one among women, who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all generations of men bless thee: for the fire of the Godhead took up His abode in thee, and as an infant thou didst feed with milk the Creator and Lord; therefore both the angelic and the human race worthily glorify thy most holy nativity, and in unison we cry unto thee: Pray Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that worship thy most holy nativity with faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, восклица́ше пла́чꙋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb, Shepherd, and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud weeping, and bitterly

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding the Lamb, Shepherd, and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud weeping, and bitterly

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. і҆рмо́съ: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ просла́вихъ твоѐ бж҃тво̀.
items.english_text: and bitterly weeping, she cried out: The world indeed rejoices, receiving redemption through Thee; but mine inward parts are ablaze beholding Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of Thy loving-kindness, O Long-suffering Lord. O abyss of mercy, and inexhaustible Fountain, have compassion, and grant remission of transgressions unto them that sing of Thy divine passions in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: and bitterly weeping, she cried out: The world indeed rejoices, receiving redemption through Thee; but mine inward parts are ablaze beholding Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of Thy loving-kindness, O Long-suffering Lord. O abyss of mercy, and inexhaustible Fountain, have compassion, and grant remission of transgressions unto them that sing of Thy divine passions in faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнѧ води́мо мꙋ́нче на же́ртвꙋ, ника́коже провѣща́лъ є҆сѝ, влⷣцѣ твоемꙋ̀ подо́бѧсѧ, є҆гѡ́же ра́ди и҆ сме́рть пренебре́глъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.[^263]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.[^263]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Цѣломꙋ́дрїемъ ᲂу҆краша́емь, и҆ съ си́мъ живы́й, строга́нїа и҆ ра̑ны тве́рдымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ твои́мъ терпѣ́въ, врагѝ саві́не низложи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a lamb led to the slaughter, O martyr, thou didst utter nothing at all, being conformed unto thy Master, for Whose sake thou didst also despise death.[^264]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a lamb led to the slaughter, O martyr, thou didst utter nothing at all, being conformed unto thy Master, for Whose sake thou didst also despise death.[^264]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пло́тскими твои́ми ᲂу҆́ды, мꙋ́чениче хрⷭ҇та̀ просла́вивъ, прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ съ прпⷣбныхъ дꙋ́хи, весе́лїе бж҃е́ственное и҆ непогыба́ющее.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with chastity and living therein, having endured scrapings and wounds with thy firm mind, O Sabinus, thou didst cast down the enemies.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Adorned with chastity and living therein, having endured scrapings and wounds with thy firm mind, O Sabinus, thou didst cast down the enemies.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Наслажда́ющесѧ пречи́стаѧ твои́хъ дарова́нїй, тебѣ̀ благода́рственное воспѣва́емъ пѣ́нїе, вѣ́дꙋще тѧ̀ бг҃ома́терь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having glorified Christ in thy bodily members, O martyr, with the spirits of the venerable thou didst receive divine and imperishable gladness.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having glorified Christ in thy bodily members, O martyr, with the spirits of the venerable thou didst receive divine and imperishable gladness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. і҆рмо́съ: Просвѣти́ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми гдⷭ҇и, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Delighting in thy gifts, O most pure one, we sing a thanksgiving hymn unto thee, knowing thee to be the Mother of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Delighting in thy gifts, O most pure one, we sing a thanksgiving hymn unto thee, knowing thee to be the Mother of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Тѧготꙋ̀ строга́нми пло́ти твоеѧ̀ ѿло́жь, дꙋ́шꙋ ᲂу҆ясни́въ, впери́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃їи саві́не, къ бж҃твенномꙋ и҆ и҆́стинномꙋ наслажде́нїю.
items.english_text: *Ode 5, Tone 8. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind.[^265]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind.[^265]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Да сла́дости пото́къ, и҆ нета́енїа добро́тꙋ ѡ҆брѧ́щеши пресла́вне, текꙋ́щꙋю мі́ра, ꙗ҆́вѣ ѡ҆плева́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cast off weight by the scraping of thy flesh, and illumined thy soul, O godly Sabinus, thou didst soar on wings unto divine and true delight.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having cast off weight by the scraping of thy flesh, and illumined thy soul, O godly Sabinus, thou didst soar on wings unto divine and true delight.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆мертвѝ чи́стаѧ страсте́й мои́хъ взыгра́нїа, тлѣ́нїа и҆збавлѧ́ющи мѧ̀: и҆ безстра́стїѧ спасе́нїе мнѣ̀ подаю́щи.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That thou mightest find the torrent of sweetness and the beauty of incorruption, O most glorious one, thou didst visibly spit upon the passing things of the world.[^266]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
That thou mightest find the torrent of sweetness and the beauty of incorruption, O most glorious one, thou didst visibly spit upon the passing things of the world.[^266]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Моли́твꙋ пролїю̀ ко гдⷭ҇ꙋ, и҆ томꙋ̀ возвѣщꙋ̀ печа́ли моѧ̑, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕѡ́лъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ и҆спо́лнисѧ, и҆ живо́тъ мо́й а҆́дꙋ прибли́жисѧ, и҆ молю́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ і҆ѡ́на, ѿ тлѝ бж҃е возведи́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Put to death the surgings of my passions, O pure one, delivering me from corruption and granting me the salvation of dispassion.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Put to death the surgings of my passions, O pure one, delivering me from corruption and granting me the salvation of dispassion.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ника́коже ѡ҆ привре́менныхъ бре́гъ, ꙗ҆́коже въ чꙋжде́мъ пло́ти претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́звы: свѧза́нїа, терза́нїа, жже́нїа, и҆ кончи́нꙋ бл҃же́ннꙋю прїе́мъ: ѿ хрⷭ҇та̀ вѣнце́въ сла́вы, саві́не ᲂу҆лꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6, Tone 8. Heirmos:* A prayer will I pour out unto the Lord, and unto Him will I proclaim my griefs; for my soul is filled with evils, and my life hath drawn near unto hades, and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God.[^267]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6, Tone 8. Heirmos:*
A prayer will I pour out unto the Lord, and unto Him will I proclaim my griefs; for my soul is filled with evils, and my life hath drawn near unto hades, and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God.[^267]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Во́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ и҆спо́лнисѧ живото́чныхъ, хрⷭ҇това це́рковь, и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ рѣчны́хъ во́дъ, тѧ̀ и҆сто́чника чꙋде́съ ѡ҆богати́в
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Taking no heed for temporary things, as though in another's flesh thou didst endure wounds, bonds, lacerations, burnings, and receiving a blessed end, thou didst obtain from Christ crowns of glory, O Sabinus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Taking no heed for temporary things, as though in another's flesh thou didst endure wounds, bonds, lacerations, burnings, and receiving a blessed end, thou didst obtain from Christ crowns of glory, O Sabinus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]

items.slavonic_text: Да сла́вꙋ нетлѣ́нную прїи́меши, сла́вꙋ ѡ҆плева́лъ є҆сѝ житїѧ̀: сла́вы ра́ди бж҃їѧ наслажда́ѧсѧ въ мꙋ́кахъ, саві́не зовы́й непреста́ннѡ: бж҃е благослове́нъ є҆сѝ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ма́нїемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ влⷣки, ѿве́рглъ є҆сѝ безбо́жныхъ ме́рзость, бж҃твеннꙋю ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆збра́въ мꙋ́дрость, саві́не поѧ̀ непреста́ннѡ: бж҃е блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That thou mightest receive imperishable glory, thou didst spit upon the glory of this life, delighting in torments for the sake of God's glory, crying out unceasingly, O Sabinus: O God, blessed art Thou.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Спасѐ мі́ръ бцⷣе, ѿ ᲂу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀ вопло́щшеесѧ сло́во бж҃тве́нное. є҆го́же почита́юще, пое́мъ тѧ̀ вопїю́ще: благослове́нъ пречⷭ҇таѧ пло́дъ твоегѡ̀ чре́ва.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the divine bidding of the Master, thou didst cast away the abomination of the godless, having visibly chosen divine wisdom, O Sabinus, singing unceasingly: O God, blessed art Thou.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The divine Word incarnate of thy womb saved the world, O Birthgiver of God; honoring Whom, we sing unto thee, crying: Blessed, O all-pure one, is the Fruit of thy womb![^271]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Прекривле́нъ бы́въ мꙋчи́телей сꙋро́вствы, хрⷭ҇то́вою же любо́вїю и҆справле́нъ, неѡ́блемо ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ та́мѡ безстра́стїе, саві́не поѧ̀ пѣ́снь гдⷭ҇ви: тѧ̀ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки. Два́жды.
items.english_text: *Ode 8, Tone 8. Heirmos:* When the musical instruments sounded in harmony, and the countless peoples worshiped the image in Dura, the three youths, refusing to obey, hymned the Lord and glorified Him unto all ages.[^272]

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆краси́лсѧ є҆сѝ мꙋ́чениче воѡдерка́нїемъ: ᲂу҆ѧсни́лсѧ є҆сѝ страда́нїй лѣ́потою, и҆ просїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́коже ѕвѣзда̀ зовꙋ́щымъ: по́йте гдⷭ҇а всѧ̑ дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Tormented by the cruelties of the persecutors, but set upright by the love of Christ, Thou didst find inviolable dispassion yonder, O Sabinus, singing a hymn unto the Lord: We supremely exalt Thee unto all ages. *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣ́тла просїѧ́ла є҆сѝ заре́ю, мы́сленнагѡ бо со́лнца ѻ҆́блакъ была̀ є҆сѝ мтѝ бж҃їѧ, ᲂу҆гаси́вшагѡ і҆́дѡлскагѡ пе́щь неи́стовства: є҆го́же превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with endurance, O martyr, thou wast made bright with the beauty of sufferings, and didst shine forth as a star unto them that cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having thee as a rampart and protection, and as our sole intercessor, O pure one, and possessing salvation, we are ever delivered from tribulations and transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ з҃і де́нь. Преподо́бнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ а҆леѯі́а чл҃ка бж҃їѧ: На гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, а҃. Подо́бенъ: В̾схва́льнїи мч҃енницы:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As a man of God we have known thee, both by name and in deed; for thou didst shine forth with virtues, having acquired boundless poverty and narrowness upon earth, and having enriched the faithful with miracles; therefore pray that there may be granted to our souls peace and great mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 1:* As a man of God we have known thee, both by name and in deed; for thou didst shine forth with virtues, having acquired boundless poverty and narrowness upon earth, and having enriched the faithful with miracles; therefore pray that there may be granted to our souls peace and great mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Чл҃ка тѧ̀ позна́хомъ бж҃їа, * зва́ніемъ же и҆ ве́щїю: * добродѣ́телми бо просїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * нищетꙋ̀ безмѣ́рнꙋю, и҆ тѣснотꙋ̀ на землѝ стѧжа́въ, * и҆ чꙋдесы̀ вѣ́рныѧ оу҆бѣри́въ: * тѣ́мже моли́сѧ * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, * ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* With the desire that dews the flesh, thou didst quench the flame of lust, O Alexis; piously didst thou exchange bridal chamber for bridal chamber, and bodily sweetness for the divine angelic likeness; with them pray that there may be granted to our souls peace and great mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 2:* With the desire that dews the flesh, thou didst quench the flame of lust, O Alexis; piously didst thou exchange bridal chamber for bridal chamber, and bodily sweetness for the divine angelic likeness; with them pray that there may be granted to our souls peace and great mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Жела́нїемъ ѡ҆роша́ющимъ пло́ть, * по́хѡти пла́мѧ * оу҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ а҆леѯі́е: * черто́гомъ черто́гъ, благоче́стнѡ и҆змѣни́лъ є҆сѝ: * сла́дость же тѣле́снꙋю, бж҃твеннымъ а҆гг҃лскимъ подо́бїемъ: * съ ни́миже моли́сѧ, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ * ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Unknown didst thou abide, O wise one, enduring affliction before the gates of thy holy parents, while thine own servants mocked thee for a long time; and having died, thou wast revealed through miracles which thou didst work, healing infirmities and driving away the spirits of malice.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 3:* Unknown didst thou abide, O wise one, enduring affliction before the gates of thy holy parents, while thine own servants mocked thee for a long time; and having died, thou wast revealed through miracles which thou didst work, healing infirmities and driving away the spirits of malice.

For thy spouse and fleeting wealth thou didst count as dust, unknown at thy father's house, desi-

For thy spouse and fleeting wealth thou didst count as dust, unknown at thy father's house, desi-

items.slavonic_text: Недꙋ́говавшꙋю прест҃а́ѧ лю́тѣ * дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ лꙋка́выми, и҆сцѣлѝ, ꙗ҆́же цѣли́телѧ и҆ сп҃са * всѣ́хъ хрⷭ҇та̀ ро́ждшаѧ: всѧ́кꙋ ꙗ҆́звꙋ * и҆сцѣли́вшаго ᲂу҆ѧ́звленнагѡ * діа́волскимъ ѕлоꙋмы́шлїемъ, * и҆ сме́рти на́съ и҆змѣ́ншаго.
items.english_text: Heal my soul that is grievously suffering from wicked passions, O most holy one, who didst bear Christ the Healer and Savior of all, Who healed every wound of him who was wounded by the devil's malice, and delivered us from death.

Whither Thy splendor? Whither the grace radiant from Thy countenance, O my most beloved Son?

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Своего̀ а҆́гнца, а҆́гница и҆ непоро́чнаѧ влⷣчца, * на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣвши зра́ка не и҆мꙋ́ща нижѐ добро́ты, * ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀, рыда́ющи гл҃го́лаше: * гдѣ̀ добро́та твоѧ̀ за́йде сла́дчайшїй? * гдѣ̀ благолѣ́пїе? * гдѣ̀ бл҃года́ть блиста́ющаѧ * ѡ҆́браза твоегѡ̀, сн҃е мо́й любезнѣ́йшїй.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Having ascended unto virtue, and having purified thy mind, thou didst attain unto the desired and ultimate summit; and having adorned thy life with dispassion, and having embraced surpassing fasting with a pure conscience, abiding in prayers as though bodiless, thou didst shine forth like the sun in the world, O most blessed Alexis.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 4:*
Having ascended unto virtue, and having purified thy mind, thou didst attain unto the desired and ultimate summit; and having adorned thy life with dispassion, and having embraced surpassing fasting with a pure conscience, abiding in prayers as though bodiless, thou didst shine forth like the sun in the world, O most blessed Alexis.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Во глубинѣ̀ постла̀ и҆ногда̀, фараѡни́тское всево́инство преѡрꙋже́ннаѧ си́ла, вопло́щшеесѧ же сло́во всеѕло́бный грѣ́хъ потреби́ло є҆́сть, препросла́вленный гдⷭ҇ь, сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: In the deep of old, the all-armed power overwhelmed the host of Pharaoh; but the Word incarnate hath abolished all-wicked sin, the most glorious Lord, for gloriously hath He been glorified.

provenance.verbatim_source: In the deep of old, the all-armed power overwhelmed the host of Pharaoh; but the Word incarnate hath abolished all-wicked sin, the most glorious Lord, for gloriously hath He been glorified.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Тѣснѣ́йшїй ше́ствовалъ є҆сѝ пꙋ́ть, непоро́чное и҆ преподо́бное житїѐ мꙋ́дре проходѧ̀ ѿ ю҆́ности: тѣ́мже мою̀ тѣснотꋋ разширѝ ᲂу҆ма̀ восхвали́ти тѧ̀, къ ра́йстѣй широтѣ̀ водворѧ́ѧсѧ а҆леѯі́е.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The narrowest path didst thou tread, traversing a blameless and venerable life from youth, O wise one; therefore widen the narrowness of my mind to praise thee, as thou dwellest in the spaciousness of paradise, O Alexis.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The narrowest path didst thou tread, traversing a blameless and venerable life from youth, O wise one; therefore widen the narrowness of my mind to praise thee, as thou dwellest in the spaciousness of paradise, O Alexis.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ сама́го всемꋋ бг҃ꋋ возложи́въ бл҃же́нне, внѣ̀ пло́ти и҆ мі́ра бы́лъ є҆сѝ: бога́тствꋋ текꙋ́щꋋ, не́ное предпочѐлъ є҆сѝ и҆ пребыва́ющее, и҆ ѡ҆бѣща́нный гра́дъ сїѡ́нъ вѣчнꋋю́щій.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having committed thyself wholly unto God, O blessed one, thou wast outside flesh and world; fleeting wealth [thou didst spurn], and preferred heavenly[^275] and enduring wealth, and the promised city, everlasting Sion.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having committed thyself wholly unto God, O blessed one, thou wast outside flesh and world; fleeting wealth [thou didst spurn], and preferred heavenly[^275] and enduring wealth, and the promised city, everlasting Sion.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ложе́снъ ты̀ ма́тернихъ непло́дїе разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ, ро́ждсѧ ꙗ҆́коже самꋋи́лъ пребога́те: во чре́вѣ же срⷭ҇ца чи́стый зача́тъ стра́хъ, роди́лъ є҆сѝ дх҃ъ сп҃се́нїѧ, бж҃твенныхъ добродѣ́телей вѣ́рою.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst loose the barrenness of thy mother's womb, being born as Samuel of old, O exceedingly rich one; and having conceived pure fear in the womb of thy heart, thou didst bring forth the spirit of salvation through the faith of divine virtues.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst loose the barrenness of thy mother's womb, being born as Samuel of old, O exceedingly rich one; and having conceived pure fear in the womb of thy heart, thou didst bring forth the spirit of salvation through the faith of divine virtues.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The co-unoriginate Son of God had thee, O Virgin, as the cause of His likeness unto us, having found thee alone pure above all creation, O immaculate one; therefore do all generations hymn thee and call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* The co-unoriginate Son of God had thee, O Virgin, as the cause of His likeness unto us, having found thee alone pure above all creation, O immaculate one; therefore do all generations hymn thee and call thee blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The desert, the barren church of the nations, hath blossomed as a lily, O Lord, by Thy coming, wherein my heart hath been established.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
The desert, the barren church of the nations, hath blossomed as a lily, O Lord, by Thy coming, wherein my heart hath been established.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Процвѣла̀ є҆́сть пꙋсты́нѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ крі́нъ гдⷭ҇и, * ꙗ҆зы́ческаѧ неплодѧ́щаѧ цр҃ковь, * прише́ствїемъ твои́мъ, * въ не́йже ᲂу҆тверди́сѧ моѐ се́рдце.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pierced by the desire of purity, thou didst exchange an earthly bridal chamber for a heavenly one, and the love of a wife for the sweetest angelic likeness.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Pierced by the desire of purity, thou didst exchange an earthly bridal chamber for a heavenly one, and the love of a wife for the sweetest angelic likeness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пронза́емь жела́нїемъ чистоты̀, * черто́гомъ и҆́же на землѝ, * нб҃ный премѣни́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ жены̀ любо́вїю, * сла́дчайшее а҆́гг҃лское подо́бїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst abandon the worldly turmoil and the burden of wealth, and having become a sojourner from thy fatherland, O blessed Alexis, didst conform thyself to Christ's poverty.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst abandon the worldly turmoil and the burden of wealth, and having become a sojourner from thy fatherland, O blessed Alexis, didst conform thyself to Christ's poverty.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Молвы̑ жите́йскїѧ, и҆ тѧ́жесть бога́тства ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ: * и҆ пресе́лникъ бы́въ ѻ҆те́чества бл҃же́нне а҆леѯі́е, * хрⷭ҇то́вѣ нищетѣ̀ подо́бѧсѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With tears and afflictions and self-mastery, O all-wise one, thou didst seek the good, when the light of understanding should come, granting dispassion to thy heart.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With tears and afflictions and self-mastery, O all-wise one, thou didst seek the good, when the light of understanding should come, granting dispassion to thy heart.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Слеза́ми и҆ болѣ́зньми, и҆ воздержа́нїемъ всемꙋ́дре, * бл҃гое взыска́лъ є҆сѝ, * когда̀ прі́идетъ свѣ́тъ ра́зꙋма, * безстра́стїе даѧ̀ срⷭ҇цꋋ твоемꋋ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is invisible to the angels on high, O pure one, being born below from thee, is beheld as perfect man, renewing the perishing world.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* He Who is invisible to the angels on high, O pure one, being born below from thee, is beheld as perfect man, renewing the perishing world.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Awed by the beauty" (Красотѣ̀):* The beauty of the world thou didst abandon, O venerable one, exchanging fleeting wealth for that which is truly unfailing and abiding, O Alexis; therefore with all the saints we glorify thee and celebrate brightly in thy memory, asking to find through thy prayers, O blessed one, great mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Awed by the beauty" (Красотѣ̀):*
The beauty of the world thou didst abandon, O venerable one, exchanging fleeting wealth for that which is truly unfailing and abiding, O Alexis; therefore with all the saints we glorify thee and celebrate brightly in thy memory, asking to find through thy prayers, O blessed one, great mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Красотѣ̀:
items.english_text: Inconceivable and incomprehensible is the dread mystery of God wrought concerning thee, O Sovereign Lady full of divine grace; for having conceived the Uncontainable One, thou didst bring Him forth, clothed in flesh from thy most pure blood; Whom do thou ever pray, O pure one, as thy Son, that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: Inconceivable and incomprehensible is the dread mystery of God wrought concerning thee, O Sovereign Lady full of divine grace; for having conceived the Uncontainable One, thou didst bring Him forth, clothed in flesh from thy most pure blood; Whom do thou ever pray, O pure one, as thy Son, that our souls may be saved.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мі́ра красотꋋ прпⷣбне ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, * премѣни́въ бога́тствомъ текꙋ́щимъ, * непреходи́мое ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆ пребыва́ющее а҆леѯі́е. * тѣ́мже со всѣ́ми тѧ̀ ст҃ы́ми сла́вимъ, * и҆ торжествꋋемъ свѣ́тлѡ въ па́мѧти твое́й, * просѧ́ще ѡ҆брѣстѝ моли́твами твои́ми, бл҃же́нне * ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The unwedded pure one and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee dead, hanging upon the Cross, maternally weeping did say: What hath the lawless and ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many and great gifts, O my Son? I hymn Thy divine condescension.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
The unwedded pure one and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee dead, hanging upon the Cross, maternally weeping did say: What hath the lawless and ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many and great gifts, O my Son? I hymn Thy divine condescension.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou hast come from the Virgin, not an envoy nor an angel, but Thyself the Lord incarnate, and hast saved all of me, a man; therefore do I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
Thou hast come from the Virgin, not an envoy nor an angel, but Thyself the Lord incarnate, and hast saved all of me, a man; therefore do I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Недомы́сленно и҆ непости́жно є҆́сть влⷣчце бг҃ора́дованнаѧ, * є҆́же содѣ́ланное ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ стра́шное бж҃їе та́инство: * и҆́бо неѡбыме́ннаго зача́нши родила̀ є҆сѝ, * пло́тїю ѡ҆бложе́на ѿ пречты́хъ крове́й твои́хъ: * є҆го́же всегда̀ чтⷭ҇аѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ сн҃а твоего̀ молѝ, * спасти́сѧ дꋋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure poverty, having become a beggar, poor even as Lazarus; for divine desire comforted thy heart, O blessed one, which longed for heavenly riches.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure poverty, having become a beggar, poor even as Lazarus; for divine desire comforted thy heart, O blessed one, which longed for heavenly riches.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A carefree and quiet life didst thou desire, eating but once[^276]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* A carefree and quiet life didst thou desire, eating but once[^276]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: но́щи ꙗ҆ды́й въ седми́цѣ а҆леѯі́е, * жела́нїемъ ѡ҆жида́ющагѡ тѧ̀, * немимотекꙋ́щагѡ всеблаже́нне наслажде́нїѧ.
items.english_text: -ce in the week, O Alexis, through longing for the unfailing delight that awaited thee, O all-blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: -ce in the week, O Alexis, through longing for the unfailing delight that awaited thee, O all-blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ бг҃ꋋ се́рдце и҆́щѧ содѣ́лати, въ домꋋ бг҃олюбна́го є҆сѝ бг҃ома́тере, сла́вне всегда̀ сѣдѣ́ти, и҆ нб҃ныѧ добро́ты созирца́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Seeking to make thy heart a temple of God, thou didst love to sit ever in the house of the God-loving Mother of God, O glorious one, and to contemplate heavenly beauties.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Seeking to make thy heart a temple of God, thou didst love to sit ever in the house of the God-loving Mother of God, O glorious one, and to contemplate heavenly beauties.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin who didst bear the milk-fed Creator, satiate now my suffering and distressed heart with all understanding and divine compunction, I pray thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O Virgin who didst bear the milk-fed Creator, satiate now my suffering and distressed heart with all understanding and divine compunction, I pray thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Созда́вшыи дѣ́телѧ де́во мл҃ка, ѕлꋋ́чꋋщее и҆ ᲂу҆тѣсне́нное ны́нѣ срⷭ҇це моѐ насы́ти всѧ́кагѡ ра́зꙋма, и҆ ᲂу҆миле́нїѧ бж҃твеннагѡ, молю́ тѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou hast been a mediator between God and men, O Christ God; for through Thee, O Master, we have access from the night of ignorance unto Thy Father, the Origin of light.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Thou hast been a mediator between God and men, O Christ God; for through Thee, O Master, we have access from the night of ignorance unto Thy Father, the Origin of light.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ever watering thy soul with sacred streams of tears, thou didst make it a truly hundredfold ear of grain, well preserved for the immortal Husbandman.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ever watering thy soul with sacred streams of tears, thou didst make it a truly hundredfold ear of grain, well preserved for the immortal Husbandman.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Хода́тай бг҃ꋋ и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е: тобо́ю бо влⷣко къ свѣтоначáлнику ѻ҆ц҃ꋋ твоемꋋ, ѿ но́щи невѣ́дѣнїѧ приведе́нїе и҆́мамы.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast seen upon earth imitating the life of the bodiless ones, by thine exceeding self-mastery, O venerable father worthy of honor, and by diligence in prayers, whereby thou wast illuminated as with light.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast seen upon earth imitating the life of the bodiless ones, by thine exceeding self-mastery, O venerable father worthy of honor, and by diligence in prayers, whereby thou wast illuminated as with light.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: То́ки сщ҃енными, напаѧ́ѧ всегда̀ сле́зъ твою̀ дꋋ́шꋋ, содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ кла́съ вои́стиннꋋ стори́чествꋋющь, дѣ́лателю безсме́ртномꋋ до́брѣ соблюда́емь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the fire of prayers thou didst consume the substance of sin, O wise one; and by vigil standings thou didst lull all voluptuousness to sleep; and having fallen asleep, thou hast passed unto the unwaning radiance.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With the fire of prayers thou didst consume the substance of sin, O wise one; and by vigil standings thou didst lull all voluptuousness to sleep; and having fallen asleep, thou hast passed unto the unwaning radiance.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́денъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ на землѝ, житїѐ безпло́тныхъ подража́ѧ: премно́гимъ твои́мъ ѻ҆́ч҃е воздержа́нїемъ досточꋋ́дне, и҆ въ моли́твахъ прилѣжа́нїемъ, и҆́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣ́томъ просвѣти́лсѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who dwells in the light took up His abode within thy holy womb, O pure one, building up again the world that was lost in the darkness of folly; Whom do thou pray to enlighten all who sing of thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* He Who dwells in the light took up His abode within thy holy womb, O pure one, building up again the world that was lost in the darkness of folly; Whom do thou pray to enlighten all who sing of thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆гне́мъ моли́твъ грѣха̀ попали́лъ є҆сѝ ве́щь мꙋ́дре: бдѣ́нными же стоѧ́ньми всѧ́кое сладостра́стїе ᲂу҆спи́лъ є҆сѝ. ᲂу҆снꋋ́въ же къ сїѧ́нїю преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ невече́рнемꋋ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Rolling in the deep of sin, I call upon the unfathomable deep of Thy tender mercy: from corruption, O God, bring me up.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
Rolling in the deep of sin, I call upon the unfathomable deep of Thy tender mercy: from corruption, O God, bring me up.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃род[иченъ]:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As thou didst become a living temple of God, the unwedded bridal chamber of Christ glorifies thee in thy beauty, and glorifies thee who wast revealed as a vessel of grace.[^277]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As thou didst become a living temple of God, the unwedded bridal chamber of Christ glorifies thee in thy beauty, and glorifies thee who wast revealed as a vessel of grace.[^277]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же во свѣ́тѣ живы́й, во ст҃о́е чре́во твоѐ всели́сѧ чтⷭ҇аѧ, мі́ръ поги́бшїй тмо́ю неразꋋ́мїѧ, па́ки назида́ѧ: є҆го́же молѝ всѧ̑ просвѣти́ти пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy prayers unto God were acceptable as incense, O blessed one; whence by thy life thou didst make fragrant the minds of the faithful with the grace of the Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thy prayers unto God were acceptable as incense, O blessed one; whence by thy life thou didst make fragrant the minds of the faithful with the grace of the Spirit.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with a holy life, Christ again gives Thee unwillingly to Thy fatherland, O glorious one, who didst flee from fleeting glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Adorned with a holy life, Christ again gives Thee unwillingly to Thy fatherland, O glorious one, who didst flee from fleeting glory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валя́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́дную млⷭ҇рдїѧ твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꋋ, ѿ тлѝ бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Creator, Who remakes the laws of nature, O pure Sovereign Lady, is ineffably born of thee, and deifies me through boundless mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* The Creator, Who remakes the laws of nature, O pure Sovereign Lady, is ineffably born of thee, and deifies me through boundless mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ хра́мъ жи́въ бж҃ій тѧ̀ бы́вша, хрⷭ҇то́во селе́нїе неискꋋсобра́чнаѧ, прославлѧ́етъ кра́сѧщасѧ: и҆ прославлѧ́етъ, ᲂу҆тли́тна тѧ̀ ꙗ҆вльшагосѧ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* Having regarded the house of thy parents as an alien dwelling, thou didst abide therein in beggar's guise; and after thy repose having received a crown of glory,[^278] glory, marvelous wast thou revealed upon earth, O Alexis, man of God, the joy of angels and men.

provenance.verbatim_source:

...glory, marvelous wast thou revealed upon earth, O Alexis, man of God, the joy of angels and men.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: сла́вы, ди́венъ на землѝ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ а҆леѯі́е чл҃вѣ́че бж҃їй, а҆́гг҃лѡмъ и҆ чл҃кѡмъ ра́дованїе.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* With life and words thou wast adorned, and the Church of Christ thou didst magnify by thy life, causing father and mother, emperor and people to celebrate; and having preserved that which is according to the image of God by deeds, O venerable Alexis, thou didst shine forth in the world by thy chastity; therefore the grace of thy virtues irradiates all who in faith celebrate thy memory, O father; for thou wast revealed as the joy of angels and men.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ikos:* With life and words thou wast adorned, and the Church of Christ thou didst magnify by thy life, causing father and mother, emperor and people to celebrate; and having preserved that which is according to the image of God by deeds, O venerable Alexis, thou didst shine forth in the world by thy chastity; therefore the grace of thy virtues irradiates all who in faith celebrate thy memory, O father; for thou wast revealed as the joy of angels and men.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: I҆́косъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The God-opposing decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread spiritual dew over the pious youths: He Who is blessed and supremely glorified.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
The God-opposing decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread spiritual dew over the pious youths: He Who is blessed and supremely glorified.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Житїе́мъ и҆ словесы̀ ᲂу҆краси́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ хрⷭ҇то́вꋋ цр҃ковь возвели́чилъ є҆сѝ твои́мъ житїе́мъ: ѻ҆ца̀ и҆ ма́терь, царѧ̀ и҆ лю́ди торжествова́ти ᲂу҆стро́ивъ: дѣ́лы же соблю́дъ є҆́же по ѡ҆́бразꋋ бж҃їю, а҆леѯі́е преподо́бне, возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ въ мі́рѣ твои́мъ цѣломꋋ́дрїемъ. тѣ́мже бл҃года́ть добродѣ́телей твои́хъ ѡ҆блиста́ваетъ всѧ̑ вѣ́рою пра́зднꋋющыѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е па́мѧть твою̀: ꙗ҆ви́лбосѧ є҆сѝ а҆́гг҃лѡмъ и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ ра́дованїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure, O venerable one, sitting before the parental gates, wholly unrecognized, enduring insults from servants, bitterly mocked, and afflicted by great poverty.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure, O venerable one, sitting before the parental gates, wholly unrecognized, enduring insults from servants, bitterly mocked, and afflicted by great poverty.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mortified the mind of thy flesh, beholding thy parents yet unrecognized by them, thou didst conceal the necessity of nature, O venerable one, and the contempt of thy foolish servants who afflicted thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having mortified the mind of thy flesh, beholding thy parents yet unrecognized by them, thou didst conceal the necessity of nature, O venerable one, and the contempt of thy foolish servants who afflicted thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃опроти́вное велѣ́нїе, беззако́ннꋋющагѡ мꋋчи́телѧ, высо́къ пла́мень вознесло̀ є҆́сть. хрⷭ҇то́съ же прострѐ бг҃очести́вымъ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ ро́сꋋ дх҃о́внꋋю: сы́й бл҃гослове́нъ и҆ препросла́вленъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O wonder! How didst thou ever abide in poverty amid the wealth of boundless humility, O Alexis? How didst thou endure mocking and reproaches from thine own servants, O all-wise one, who knew not thy life?

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O wonder! How didst thou ever abide in poverty amid the wealth of boundless humility, O Alexis? How didst thou endure mocking and reproaches from thine own servants, O all-wise one, who knew not thy life?
