items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне, пред̾ роди́телными враты̀ сѣдѧ̀, и҆ весьма̀ непознава́емь, и҆ ѿ ѻ҆́трѡкъ рꙋга́нїѧ подъе́млѧ, и҆ нарꋋга́емь лю́тѣ, и҆ нището́ю мно́гою ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the minister of a great mystery, O all-immaculate one; for thou didst incarnate God Who delivered us from great evils, who magnify thee, O pure, blessed one, full of divine grace.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the minister of a great mystery, O all-immaculate one; for thou didst incarnate God Who delivered us from great evils, who magnify thee, O pure, blessed one, full of divine grace.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пло́ти твоеѧ̀ мꋋдрова́нїе ᲂу҆мертви́въ, зрѧ̀ роди́тели, и҆ си́ми непознава́емь: є҆стества̀ покрыва́лъ є҆сѝ нꋋ́ждꋋ преподо́бне, и҆ презрѣ́нїе твои́хъ неискꋋ́сныхъ ѻ҆́трѡкъ, ѡ҆скорблѧ́ющихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by divine command, consuming the Chaldeans, but bedewing the faithful who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by divine command, consuming the Chaldeans, but bedewing the faithful who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ чꋋ́до! ка́кѡ пребы́лъ є҆сѝ при́снѡ нище́тствꋋѧ, въ бога́тствѣ а҆леѯі́е безмѣ́рнагѡ смире́нїѧ? ка́кѡ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ рꙋга́нїе и҆ ᲂу҆кори́зны, ѿ ѻ҆́трѡкъ премꋋ́дре твои́хъ, невѣ́дѣвшихъ житїѧ̀ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unknown before as a son to thy parents, at the time of thy departure thou didst reveal the secret unto them, being manifested to the glory of our God, O glorious one, Who hath greatly and worthily glorified thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Unknown before as a son to thy parents, at the time of thy departure thou didst reveal the secret unto them, being manifested to the glory of our God, O glorious one, Who hath greatly and worthily glorified thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord with a great voice reveals Thee to all Rome, a hidden treasure, O exceedingly rich one, lying in beggar's form, and enriching all who come to Thee in faith with the gifts of healings.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Lord with a great voice reveals Thee to all Rome, a hidden treasure, O exceedingly rich one, lying in beggar's form, and enriching all who come to Thee in faith with the gifts of healings.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Вели́кагѡ слꋋжи́тельница ты̀ та́инства была̀ є҆сѝ всенепоро́чнаѧ: бг҃а бо воплоти́ла є҆сѝ, вели́кихъ ѕѡ́лъ на́съ и҆зба́вльшаго, тѧ̀ велича́ющыѧ чтⷭ҇аѧ, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ бг҃ора́дованнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The princes of the people and kings came together, and the priests, O blessed one,[^279] to bury thee, by the divine beckoning; and beholding a great vision, they marveled at the miracles, O venerable one, which thou didst work by the divine power of the Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* The princes of the people and kings came together, and the priests, O blessed one,[^279]
...to bury thee, by the divine beckoning; and beholding a great vision, they marveled at the miracles, O venerable one, which thou didst work by the divine power of the Spirit.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: же́нне погребсти́ тѧ, бж҃їимъ манове́нїемъ: и҆ ви́дѧще ве́лїе видѣ́нїе, диви́шасѧ чꋋдесе́мъ преподо́бне, ꙗ҆́же твори́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃твенною си́лою дх҃а.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Renewing us who of old were corrupted through transgression, the Lover of mankind was incorruptibly incarnate from thy most pure womb, O all-immaculate one, and delivered all from the corruptions of sin, O Bride of God.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Renewing us who of old were corrupted through transgression, the Lover of mankind was incorruptibly incarnate from thy most pure womb, O all-immaculate one, and delivered all from the corruptions of sin, O Bride of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The Son of the unoriginate Father, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin hath appeared unto us, to enlighten the darkened and to gather the scattered; therefore the all-hymned Birthgiver of God do we magnify.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
The Son of the unoriginate Father, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin hath appeared unto us, to enlighten the darkened and to gather the scattered; therefore the all-hymned Birthgiver of God do we magnify.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вшыѧ ны̀ дре́вле престꋋпле́нїемъ, ѡ҆бновлѧ́ѧ человѣколю́бецъ, нетлѣ́ннѡ воплоти́сѧ, ѿ нетлѣ́нныѧ твоеѧ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ ᲂу҆тро́бы. и҆ и҆зба́ви всѣ́хъ грѣхо́вныхъ тлѣ́й бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst pour forth healings while being carried to the grave, God glorifying thee greatly, O blessed one; for the sightless saw the light, and those who before were mute received speech, O all-glorious Alexis.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst pour forth healings while being carried to the grave, God glorifying thee greatly, O blessed one; for the sightless saw the light, and those who before were mute received speech, O all-glorious Alexis.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast seen lying in state, and being carried to burial, like the sun emitting beams of healings most gloriously, O father, driving away dark passions, and burning demons, and enlightening the godly-wise.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast seen lying in state, and being carried to burial, like the sun emitting beams of healings most gloriously, O father, driving away dark passions, and burning demons, and enlightening the godly-wise.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Безнача́лна роди́телѧ сн҃ъ, бг҃ъ и҆ гдⷭ҇ь, вопло́щсѧ ѿ дв҃ы на́мъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, ѡ҆мраче́ннаѧ просвѣти́ти, собра́ти расточе́ннаѧ. тѣ́мъ всепѣ́тꋋю бцⷣꋋ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The foremost of the patriarchs came to bury thee, and the emperor most Christ-loving of all, princes, elders, and youths, and the choirs of monastics, by the divine beckoning, being sanctified by thy touch, O blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The foremost of the patriarchs came to bury thee, and the emperor most Christ-loving of all, princes, elders, and youths, and the choirs of monastics, by the divine beckoning, being sanctified by thy touch, O blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́нїѧ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ къ гро́бꋋ несо́мь, бг҃ꋋ тѧ̀ блаже́нне вельмѝ сла́вѧщꋋ: свѣ́тъ бо неви́дѧщїи ви́дѣша, и҆ глаго́ланїе прїѧ́ша пре́жде сꋋ́ще нѣмі́и, всесла́вне а҆леѯі́е.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast caught up, borne upon the chariot of virtues, and thou restest where the ranks of the venerable, the assembly of apostles and martyrs, patriarchs, and all the righteous abide; with them remember us who honor thee, O Alexis.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast caught up, borne upon the chariot of virtues, and thou restest where the ranks of the venerable, the assembly of apostles and martyrs, patriarchs, and all the righteous abide; with them remember us who honor thee, O Alexis.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́денъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ предлежа́щь, и҆ къ погребе́нїю несо́мь, ꙗ҆́кѡ со́лнце ѻ҆́ч҃е и҆спꋋща́ѧ и҆сцѣле́ній зари̑ пресла́внѡ: и҆ те́мныѧ стра́сти ѿгонѧ̀, и҆ ѡ҆палѧ́ѧ де́моны, и҆ просвѣща́ѧ бг҃омоꙋ́дрыѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We offer thee Gabriel's greeting, O all-immaculate one, saying: Rejoice, untilled field; rejoice, loosed curse; rejoice, fountain of living water, boast of the venerable, Birthgiver of God, ever-virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* We offer thee Gabriel's greeting, O all-immaculate one, saying: Rejoice, untilled field; rejoice, loosed curse; rejoice, fountain of living water, boast of the venerable, Birthgiver of God, ever-virgin.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Прїи́де погребсти́ тѧ патрїа́рхѡвъ первѣ́йшїй: цр҃ь же всѣ́ми хрⷭ҇толюбезнѣ́йшїй, кнѧ́зи, ста́рцы, и҆ ю҆́нїи, и҆ мона́шествꋋющихъ ли́цы, бж҃твеннымъ манове́нїемъ, ѡ҆сщ҃а́ющесѧ прикоснове́нїемъ твои́мъ блаже́нне.
items.english_text: *March 18: Commemoration of our Father among the Saints, Cyril, Archbishop of Jerusalem*[^280]

provenance.verbatim_source: *March 18: Commemoration of our Father among the Saints, Cyril, Archbishop of Jerusalem*[^280]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Like a star didst thou shine forth, and didst enlighten the faithful with the sacred splendors of thy dogmas, and didst darken heresies[^281] darkened heresies, and vanquished them to the end; and as a servant thou didst multiply the talent given unto thee, having well-pleased the Master, O godly-wise one, into Whose hands thou didst commit thy spirit, O divinely-blessed Cyril.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 1:* Like a star didst thou shine forth, and didst enlighten the faithful with the sacred splendors of thy dogmas, and didst darken heresies[^281]
...darkened heresies, and vanquished them to the end; and as a servant thou didst multiply the talent given unto thee, having well-pleased the Master, O godly-wise one, into Whose hands thou didst commit thy spirit, O divinely-blessed Cyril.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: мра́чилъ є҆сѝ, и҆ до конца̀ побѣди́въ: и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́бъ да́нный тебѣ̀ тала́нтъ ᲂу҆мно́жилъ є҆сѝ, бл҃гоꙋго́дивъ влⷣцѣ бг҃омꋋ́дре: є҆мꋋ́же въ рꋋ́цѣ ѿложи́лъ є҆сѝ тво́й дх҃ъ, бг҃облаже́нне кѷрі́лле.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* By the wisdom of thy words and the radiance of thy life, like a star of many lights, O worthy of honor, thou didst shine forth in the midst of the council of the fathers; the godless Macedonius thou didst strangle with the sinews of grace, who foolishly blasphemed the holy, life-creating, divine Spirit, and manifestly committed lawlessness.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 2:* By the wisdom of thy words and the radiance of thy life, like a star of many lights, O worthy of honor, thou didst shine forth in the midst of the council of the fathers; the godless Macedonius thou didst strangle with the sinews of grace, who foolishly blasphemed the holy, life-creating, divine Spirit, and manifestly committed lawlessness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Премꋋ́дростїю слове́съ твои́хъ, * и҆ сїѧ́нїемъ житїѧ̀ твоегѡ̀, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕвѣзда̀ многосвѣ́тлаѧ досточꋋ́дне, * посредѝ собо́ра просїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆це́въ, * безбо́жнаго македо́нїа * жи́лами ᲂу҆дави́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃года́ти: * и҆ ст҃ы́й и҆ ѡ҆живла́ющій всѧ̑ бж҃е́ственный дх҃ъ, * хꋋ́лившаго безꋋ́мнѡ, * и҆ проѧвле́ннѡ безаконнова́вшаго.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The ruinous mind of the most foolish Manes thou didst put to shame, having excellently and most wisely refuted the vile doctrines of his frenzy, O chief of teachers, splendor of priests, divine champion of the Church of Christ; therefore, glorifying thy holy dormition, we celebrate it.[^282]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 3:* The ruinous mind of the most foolish Manes thou didst put to shame, having excellently and most wisely refuted the vile doctrines of his frenzy, O chief of teachers, splendor of priests, divine champion of the Church of Christ; therefore, glorifying thy holy dormition, we celebrate it.[^282]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ. Гла́съ, и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже:
items.english_text: Choice repentance and saving medicine, O thou who didst bear God my Savior, and streams of tears, and meditation upon the dread and fearful hour and unbribable judgment, do thou grant me to escape through thy prayers, O Virgin, from trembling torment, and to obtain divine grace.

provenance.verbatim_source: Choice repentance and saving medicine, O thou who didst bear God my Savior, and streams of tears, and meditation upon the dread and fearful hour and unbribable judgment, do thou grant me to escape through thy prayers, O Virgin, from trembling torment, and to obtain divine grace.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Покаѧ́нїе и҆зрѧ́дное * и҆ сп҃си́телное враче́вство, * ꙗ҆́же бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ сп҃са моего̀, * и҆ сле́зъ то́ки, * и҆ часа̀ помы́слъ гро́знагѡ и҆ стра́шнагѡ, * и҆ сꋋда̀ неᲂу҆мы́тнагѡ, * ты́ ми да́рꋋй и҆збѣжа́ти моли́твами твои́ми, * Ѽ дв҃о, мꋋче́нїѧ трепе́тнагѡ! * и҆ бж҃е́ственнꋋю ᲂу҆лꋋчи́ти бл҃года́ть.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, the ewe-lamb and Thy Mother marveled, and cried aloud: What vision is this, O longed-for Son? Hath the ungrateful and lawless assembly rendered these things unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many wonders? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:*
Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, the ewe-lamb and Thy Mother marveled, and cried aloud: What vision is this, O longed-for Son? Hath the ungrateful and lawless assembly rendered these things unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many wonders? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Трїста́ты крѣ̑пкїѧ, рожде́йса ѿ дв҃ы, безстра́стїѧ во глубинѣ̀, дꋋшѝ трїча́стное потопѝ молю́сѧ, да тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ тѷмпа́нѣ, во ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїи тѣлесѐ побѣ́дное воспою̀ пѣ́нїе.
items.english_text: The three captains of old, O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin, in the deep of dispassion do Thou drown, I pray, the tripartite part of my soul, that unto Thee as on a timbrel, in the mortification of the body, I may sing a song of victory.

provenance.verbatim_source: The three captains of old, O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin, in the deep of dispassion do Thou drown, I pray, the tripartite part of my soul, that unto Thee as on a timbrel, in the mortification of the body, I may sing a song of victory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆краси́въ дꋋ́шꋋ добродѣ́телей ви́ды, бл҃года́ти прїѧ́телищꋋ дх҃а сїю̀ ст҃а́гѡ, соверши́лъ є҆сѝ: ѿню́дꋋже бе́зднꋋ премꋋ́дрости ᲂу҆ра́гнꋋлъ є҆сѝ, є҆ресе́й пꋋчи́ны и҆зсꋋша́ющꋋ кѷрі́лле.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having adorned thy soul with forms of virtues, thou didst make it a vessel of the grace of the Holy Spirit, whence thou didst draw up the abyss of wisdom, drying up the deeps of heresies, O Cyril.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having adorned thy soul with forms of virtues, thou didst make it a vessel of the grace of the Holy Spirit, whence thou didst draw up the abyss of wisdom, drying up the deeps of heresies, O Cyril.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Превы́сшїй ᲂу҆́мъ ве́щныхъ содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ: невеще́ственныхъ слꋋжи́телей, соѻ́бщникъ показа́всѧ. Ѻ҆гне́мъ же слове́съ твои́хъ, всю̀ попали́лъ є҆сѝ ве́щь є҆ресе́й кѷрі́лле, цр҃ко́вное свѣти́ло неᲂу҆гаса́ющее.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst render thy mind superior to material things, appearing as a companion of immaterial ministers; and with the fire of thy words thou didst consume all the matter of heresies, O Cyril, unquenchable luminary of the Church.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst render thy mind superior to material things, appearing as a companion of immaterial ministers; and with the fire of thy words thou didst consume all the matter of heresies, O Cyril, unquenchable luminary of the Church.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Глагѡ́лъ твои́хъ вонѧ́ми сладкодыха́телными, неи́стовства тезоимени́тнагѡ премꋋ́дре, є҆ресе́й всѣ́хъ нестерпи́мый ка́лъ ѿгна́въ дале́че сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь и҆́стиннѣйшїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ хрⷭ҇тово бл҃гово́нїе бы́въ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the sweet-breathing fragrance of thy words, O most wise one, thou didst drive far away the intolerable filth of all the heresies of him who was named after madness,[^283] as a most true shepherd, having become the sweet fragrance of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With the sweet-breathing fragrance of thy words, O most wise one, thou didst drive far away the intolerable filth of all the heresies of him who was named after madness,[^283] as a most true shepherd, having become the sweet fragrance of Christ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From the weight of passions, from the tempest of thoughts, from the arrows of the crafty one, from every assault of the adversary, do thou save, O pure Mother of God, the souls of those who hymn thy ineffable childbearing, O all-immaculate one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* From the weight of passions, from the tempest of thoughts, from the arrows of the crafty one, from every assault of the adversary, do thou save, O pure Mother of God, the souls of those who hymn thy ineffable childbearing, O all-immaculate one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тѧгче́нїѧ страсте́й, помышле́ній треволне́нїѧ, ѿ стрѣ́лъ лꋋка́вагѡ, ѿ всѧ́кагѡ прило́га сопроти́внагѡ сп҃си чи́стаѧ бг҃ороди́тельнице, дꋋ́шы воспѣва́ющихъ, твоѐ неска́занное ржⷭ҇тво всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* As the barren church of the nations hath brought forth, and the assembly multiple in children hath grown weak, unto our marvelous God let us cry aloud: Holy art Thou, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
As the barren church of the nations hath brought forth, and the assembly multiple in children hath grown weak, unto our marvelous God let us cry aloud: Holy art Thou, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shining with the splendors of spiritual wisdom, O father, thou didst clearly explain to those on earth the tri-hypostatic Godhead of the Trinity, whereby we have been delivered from the darkness of delusion.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Shining with the splendors of spiritual wisdom, O father, thou didst clearly explain to those on earth the tri-hypostatic Godhead of the Trinity, whereby we have been delivered from the darkness of delusion.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ непло́ды родѝ ѿ ꙗ҆зы́къ цр҃ковь, и҆ мно́гое въ ча́дѣхъ и҆знемо́же со́нмище, чꋋ́дномꋋ бг҃ꋋ на́шемꋋ возопїи́мъ: ст҃ъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast revealed as a harp of the All-Holy Spirit, O godly-wise one, sounding forth the hymn of Christ's manifestation, Whom thou didst proclaim in two natures, sweetening our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast revealed as a harp of the All-Holy Spirit, O godly-wise one, sounding forth the hymn of Christ's manifestation, Whom thou didst proclaim in two natures, sweetening our souls.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сїа́ѧ свѣ́тлостьми дх҃о́вныѧ премꋋ́дрости, трїѵпоста́сное бж҃тво трⷪ҇цы, ѻ҆́ч҃е, свѣ́тлѡ сꋋ́щымъ на землѝ ᲂу҆ꙗ҆сни́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже тмы̀ пре́лести и҆зба́вихомсѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A house of holiness was thy soul revealed to be, wherein the Father, and the Son, and the Life-Originating Spirit supernaturally made Their abode; unto Whom we sing: Holy art Thou, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* A house of holiness was thy soul revealed to be, wherein the Father, and the Son, and the Life-Originating Spirit supernaturally made Their abode; unto Whom we sing: Holy art Thou, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Цѣвни́ца ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ всест҃а́гѡ дх҃а бг҃омꋋ́дре, возглаша́ющи пѣ́снь ꙗ҆вле́нїа хрⷭ҇то́ва: є҆го́же во дво́ю є҆стества́хъ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ, ᲂу҆слажда́ѧ дꋋ́шы на́ша.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Not even a heavenly mind can recount thy childbearing that surpasses understanding, O Maiden; for in thy womb, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Word of the primal Mind, Who framed all things by His Word.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Not even a heavenly mind can recount thy childbearing that surpasses understanding, O Maiden; for in thy womb, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Word of the primal Mind, Who framed all things by His Word.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: До́мъ ст҃ы́ни твоѧ̀ дꋋша̀ показа́сѧ: въ него́же ѻ҆ц҃ъ, и҆ сн҃ъ, и҆ дх҃ъ живонача́лный преесте́ственнѡ всели́сѧ. є҆мꋋ́же пое́мъ: ст҃ъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꋋ́дрости):* Having been enriched with the wisdom of the Word, thou didst pour forth living rivers of teachings, and didst water all the thought of the pious; and with the divine staff thou didst pasture the flock on the grass, and didst nourish it with divine understanding; therefore as a great shepherd and teacher, and champion of the faithful, we praise thee, O holy Cyril, crying: Pray to Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy holy memory with love.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꋋ́дрости):*
Having been enriched with the wisdom of the Word, thou didst pour forth living rivers of teachings, and didst water all the thought of the pious; and with the divine staff thou didst pasture the flock on the grass, and didst nourish it with divine understanding; therefore as a great shepherd and teacher, and champion of the faithful, we praise thee, O holy Cyril, crying: Pray to Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy holy memory with love.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ни́же ᲂу҆́мъ нб҃ный, па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ ржⷭ҇тва твоегѡ̀ мо́жетъ сказа́ти ѻ҆трокови́це: ᲂу҆ма̀ бо пе́рваго во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ сло́во чтⷭ҇аѧ зачала̀ є҆сѝ, всѧ́ческаѧ сло́вомъ соста́вльшаго.
items.english_text: As a Virgin and alone among women, who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all generations of men call thee blessed; for the fire of the Godhead made its abode in thee, and as an infant thou didst suckle the Creator and Lord; therefore both the angelic and human race worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord we cry unto thee: Pray to Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who worship in faith thy most holy childbearing.

provenance.verbatim_source:
As a Virgin and alone among women, who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all generations of men call thee blessed; for the fire of the Godhead made its abode in thee, and as an infant thou didst suckle the Creator and Lord; therefore both the angelic and human race worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord we cry...
...unto thee: Pray to Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who worship in faith thy most holy childbearing.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: вопїе́мъ тѝ: молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, покланѧ́ющымсѧ вѣ́рою прест҃о́мꋋ рождествꋋ твоемꋋ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the ewe-lamb exclaimed weeping, and bitterly sobbing cried aloud: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of Thy loving-kindness, O long-suffering Lord, abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain: have mercy, and grant remission of transgressions unto those who sing in faith of Thy divine passions.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the ewe-lamb exclaimed weeping, and bitterly sobbing cried aloud: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of Thy loving-kindness, O long-suffering Lord, abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain: have mercy, and grant remission of transgressions unto those who sing in faith of Thy divine passions.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thy virtue hath covered the heavens, and the earth is full of Thy glory, O Christ; therefore in faith do we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
Thy virtue hath covered the heavens, and the earth is full of Thy glory, O Christ; therefore in faith do we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, восклица́ше пла́чꋋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ рыда́ющи, вопїѧ́ше: мі́ръ ᲂу҆́бѡ ра́дꋋетсѧ прїе́млѧ тобо́ю и҆збавле́нїе. ᲂу҆тро́ба же моѧ̀ гори́тъ зрѧ́щи твоѐ распѧ́тїе, є҆́же те́рпиши за млⷭ҇рдїе мл҃ти, долготерпѣли́ве гдⷭ҇и, мл҃ти бе́здно, и҆ и҆сто́чниче неисчерпа́емый, ᲂу҆млⷭ҇рдисѧ и҆ да́рꋋй согрѣше́ній ѡ҆ставле́нїе, вѣ́рою пою́щымъ бж҃твенныѧ стра̑сти твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy heart having received the stream of transcendent wisdom, O venerable one, poured forth an abyss of teachings, drowning the minds of the impious.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thy heart having received the stream of transcendent wisdom, O venerable one, poured forth an abyss of teachings, drowning the minds of the impious.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* One power, one essence, one will of the tri-hypostatic Godhead didst thou proclaim, and the torrent of the delusion of polytheism, O Cyril, didst thou dry up.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* One power, one essence, one will of the tri-hypostatic Godhead didst thou proclaim, and the torrent of the delusion of polytheism, O Cyril, didst thou dry up.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Нб҃са̀ добродѣ́тель твоѧ̀ покры́ла є҆́сть, и҆ землѧ̀ и҆спо́лнисѧ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ. тѣ́мже вѣ́рнѡ вопїе́мъ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The filthy and most foolish mind of Manes,[^284] as one possessed of mind and divinely taught, O blessed one, having consumed with the splendors of thy words, thou didst manifestly refute.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The filthy and most foolish mind of Manes,[^284] as one possessed of mind and divinely taught, O blessed one, having consumed with the splendors of thy words, thou didst manifestly refute.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Премі́рныѧ мꋋ́дрости, стрꋋ́ю прпⷣбне твоѐ срⷭ҇це прїе́мшо ѿры́гнꋋ ᲂу҆че́нїа бе́зднꋋ, ᲂу҆мы̑ нече́ствꋋющихъ погрꋋжа́ющꋋю.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As higher than all creations, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Creator of creation; and having borne Him beyond nature, Who renewed our nature.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* As higher than all creations, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Creator of creation; and having borne Him beyond nature, Who renewed our nature.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́нꋋ крѣ́пость, є҆ди́но сꋋ́щество, є҆ди́нꋋ во́лю, трїѵпоста́снагѡ бж҃ества̀ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ. и҆ многобо́жїа кѷрі́лле, пре́лести пото́къ и҆зсꋋши́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as light, a holy light turning from gloomy ignorance those who hymn Thee in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as light, a holy light turning from gloomy ignorance those who hymn Thee in faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ ка́лный и҆ пребезꋋ́мный ма́нентовъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆́мъ и҆́мый, и҆ бг҃онаᲂу҆че́нъ блаже́нне, блиста́нїи слове́съ твои́хъ, попали́въ ꙗ҆́вѣ ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the staff of thy honorable wisdom, O hierarch, thou didst pasture thy flock upon the water of Orthodox worship, O blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With the staff of thy honorable wisdom, O hierarch, thou didst pasture thy flock upon the water of Orthodox worship, O blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy word, illuminated by divine light, O Cyril, dispersed the mist of ignorance of the enlightened in Jerusalem.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thy word, illuminated by divine light, O Cyril, dispersed the mist of ignorance of the enlightened in Jerusalem.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ вы́шши всѣ́хъ тва́рей чи́стаѧ, творца̀ тва́ри зачала̀ є҆сѝ: и҆ па́че є҆стества̀ ро́ждши, є҆стество̀ на́ше ѡ҆бнови́вшаго.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The night of passions and the blackness of evils covers my soul, O all-pure one; do thou who didst bear the Giver of light illumine me, I pray.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* The night of passions and the blackness of evils covers my soul, O all-pure one; do thou who didst bear the Giver of light illumine me, I pray.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Prefiguring the three-day burial, the Prophet Jonah cried out, praying in the sea-monster: From corruption deliver me, O Jesus, King of powers.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
Prefiguring the three-day burial, the Prophet Jonah cried out, praying in the sea-monster: From corruption deliver me, O Jesus, King of powers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ гдⷭ҇и мо́й свѣ́тъ въ мі́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тъ ст҃ы́й, ѡ҆браща́ѧй и҆з̾ мра́чна невѣ́дѣнїѧ, вѣ́рою воспѣва́ющыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a river issuing from another Eden didst thou come forth, full of the life-flowing waters of the Spirit, and the church's furrows, O hierarch, thou dost water.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* As a river issuing from another Eden didst thou come forth, full of the life-flowing waters of the Spirit, and the church's...
...furrows, O hierarch, thou dost water.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: и҆ цр҃ко́вныѧ ст҃и́телю напоѧ́еши бразды̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the beams of thy words, as from the tempest of the sea of impiety, thou dost save the people, O most sacred one, calling them unto the calm harbor of Orthodoxy.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With the beams of thy words, as from the tempest of the sea of impiety, thou dost save the people, O most sacred one, calling them unto the calm harbor of Orthodoxy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Глагѡ́лъ твои́хъ лꋋче́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ бꋋ́ри морскі́ѧ нече́стїѧ, спаса́еши лю́ди ѡ҆сщ҃еннѣ́йше, къ ти́хомꋋ приста́нищꋋ правосла́вїѧ, тѣ́хъ призыва́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst heavenify human nature that was grounded on earth, O all-immaculate one, and this that was corrupted thou didst remake; therefore, O Maiden, with unceasing voices we glorify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Thou didst heavenify human nature that was grounded on earth, O all-immaculate one, and this that was corrupted thou didst remake; therefore, O Maiden, with unceasing voices we glorify thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 1:* By thy tongue, O wise one, with divine inspirations, thou didst enlighten thy people to honor the Trinity, single and undivided in essence, yet divided in persons; therefore rejoicing, we celebrate thy all-holy memory, putting thee forward as an intercessor with God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 1:*
By thy tongue, O wise one, with divine inspirations, thou didst enlighten thy people to honor the Trinity, single and undivided in essence, yet divided in persons; therefore rejoicing, we celebrate thy all-holy memory, putting thee forward as an intercessor with God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆небе́сила є҆сѝ ѡ҆земле́ствованное є҆стество̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ чл҃ческое, и҆ и҆стлѣ́вшее сїѐ новогодѣ́лала є҆сѝ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди ѻ҆трокови́це, всѝ немо́лчными гла́сы тѧ̀ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The three youths in Babylon, turning the tyrant's command into folly, cried in the midst of the flame: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
The three youths in Babylon, turning the tyrant's command into folly, cried in the midst of the flame: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, а҃:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having the fire of the fear of God in thy mind, O father, thou didst reduce the substance of passions to ashes, singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having the fire of the fear of God in thy mind, O father, thou didst reduce the substance of passions to ashes, singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆зы́комъ твои́мъ мꋋ́дре, бж҃твенными вдохнове́нми, просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ твоѧ̑ лю́ди, є҆ди́нꋋ честѝ трⷪ҇цꋋ, є҆стество́мъ нераздѣ́льнꋋ, раздѣлѧ́емꋋ же ли́цы. тѣ́мже ра́дꋋющесѧ, всест҃ꋋ́ю твою̀ па́мѧть пра́зднꋋемъ, и҆́же къ бг҃ꋋ моли́твенника тѧ̀ предлага́ющїи.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having extinguished the flame of passions with tears, O blessed one, thou didst preserve the brightness of thy soul unharmed, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having extinguished the flame of passions with tears, O blessed one, thou didst preserve the brightness of thy soul unharmed, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having a living stream by the outpouring of the Spirit, unto thy soul, O godly-wise father, thou didst pour forth rivers of teachings, watering the Church that piously honors thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having a living stream by the outpouring of the Spirit, unto thy soul, O godly-wise father, thou didst pour forth rivers of teachings, watering the Church that piously honors thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ношы трѝ въ вавѷлѡ́нѣ, велѣ́нїе мꋋчи́телско на бꋋ́йство прело́жше, посредѣ̀ пла́мене вопїѧ́хꋋ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He hath sanctified thee, the Holy One Who borrowed flesh for Himself from thy flesh, O Birthgiver of God, the Lord God of our fathers Who lives in the saints.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* He hath sanctified thee, the Holy One Who borrowed flesh for Himself from thy flesh, O Birthgiver of God, the Lord God of our fathers Who lives in the saints.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́ѧ ѻ҆́гнь во ᲂу҆мѣ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е, стра́ха бж҃їа, ве́щь и҆спепели́лъ є҆сѝ страсте́й, воспѣва́ѧ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* O almighty Deliverer of all, having descended, Thou didst bedew those who acted piously in the midst of the flame, and didst teach them to sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works, sing ye the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
O almighty Deliverer of all, having descended, Thou didst bedew those who acted piously in the midst of the flame, and didst teach them to sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works, sing ye the Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Слеза́ми страсте́й пла́мень погаси́въ блаже́нне, свѣ́тлость сохрани́лъ є҆сѝ невреди́мꋋ твоеѧ̀ дꋋшѝ, взыва́ѧ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having shaken off the slumber of negligence from the eyelids of thy soul, O blessed one, thou hast now fallen asleep with the sleep becoming to the righteous, and hast come unto the day of unwaning light.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having shaken off the slumber of negligence from the eyelids of thy soul, O blessed one, thou hast now fallen asleep with the sleep becoming to the righteous, and hast come unto the day of unwaning light.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Стрꋋ́ю жи́вꋋ и҆мѣ́ѧ лїѧ́нїемъ дх҃а, къ дꋋшѝ бгомоꙋ́дре источи́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е рѣ́ки ᲂу҆че́ній цр҃ковь напоѧ́ющыѧ, бл҃гоче́стнѡ тѧ̀ чествꋋ́ющꋋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the lightnings of thy words, thou didst consume the brushwood heresy, O ever-memorable one, and didst enlighten the faithful to honor the Trinity in unity of essence, depicted in three Persons.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With the lightnings of thy words, thou didst consume the brushwood heresy, O ever-memorable one, and didst enlighten the faithful to honor the Trinity in unity of essence, depicted in three Persons.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cleansed thyself by fasting, unto Him Who became dead for thy sake thou didst offer unbloody sacrifice, as a divine hierarch and as...[^285] a minister of ineffable mysteries, O Cyril.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having cleansed thyself by fasting, unto Him Who became dead for thy sake thou didst offer unbloody sacrifice, as a divine hierarch and as...[^285]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ та́инъ неизрече́нныхъ слꋋжи́тель кѷрі́лле.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having been delivered from the ancestral curse through thee, O pure Mother of God, blessed Sovereign Lady, we bless, O all-glorified Virgin, thy most holy childbearing, O all-pure one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having been delivered from the ancestral curse through thee, O pure Mother of God, blessed Sovereign Lady, we bless, O all-glorified Virgin, thy most holy childbearing, O all-pure one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Eve indeed through the disease of disobedience brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, by the budding of the fruit of thy womb, hast blossomed forth blessing unto the world; therefore we all magnify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Eve indeed through the disease of disobedience brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, by the budding of the fruit of thy womb, hast blossomed forth blessing unto the world; therefore we all magnify thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́вльшаѧ клѧ́твы прама́тернїѧ, тобо́ю чтⷭ҇аѧ бгома́ти, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ влⷣчце: блгⷭ҇ви́мъ дв҃це препросла́вленнаѧ, прест҃о́е ржⷭ҇тво твоѐ всечи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the ineffable glory of Christ, O hierarch, thou didst strive to mortify the soul-corrupting passions, to make thy heart a dwelling-place of higher and better wisdom; therefore in faith we call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the ineffable glory of Christ, O hierarch, thou didst strive to mortify the soul-corrupting passions, to make thy heart a dwelling-place of higher and better wisdom; therefore in faith we call thee blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a star of many lights, Christ the Sun set thee upon the height of the Church, O Cyril, illuminating with the beams of sacred teachings the hearts of those who faithfully celebrate thy light-bearing memory, O venerable one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As a star of many lights, Christ the Sun set thee upon the height of the Church, O Cyril, illuminating with the beams of sacred teachings the hearts of those who faithfully celebrate thy light-bearing memory, O venerable one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆́ѵа ᲂу҆́бѡ недꋋ́гомъ преслꋋша́нїѧ, клѧ́твꋋ всели́ла є҆́сть. ты́ же дв҃о бцⷣе, прозѧбе́нїемъ чревоноше́нїѧ, мі́рови бл҃гослове́нїе процвѣла̀ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast a companion and fellow-minister of the angels; for having lived upon earth as one bodiless, O father, thou wast revealed as a partaker with the venerable, and an equal in station with the hierarchs; with them remember us this day.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast a companion and fellow-minister of the angels; for having lived upon earth as one bodiless, O father, thou wast revealed as a partaker with the venerable, and an equal in station with the hierarchs; with them remember us this day.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣти жела́ѧ хрⷭ҇то́вꋋ неизрече́ннꋋю ст҃и́телю сла́вꋋ, потща́лсѧ є҆сѝ стра̑сти ᲂу҆мертви́ти дꋋшетлѣ́нныѧ: прїѧ́телище се́рдце сотвори́ти премꋋ́дрости бѡ́льшїѧ, и҆ лꋋ́чшїѧ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ вѣ́рою ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Show my heart, which is barren of divine virtues, O most pure Birthgiver of God, to be fruitful, O Virgin who wast born of a barren woman by the will of Him Who transforms all things by His nod, that I may hymn thee, the all-praised one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Show my heart, which is barren of divine virtues, O most pure Birthgiver of God, to be fruitful, O Virgin who wast born of a barren woman by the will of Him Who transforms all things by His nod, that I may hymn thee, the all-praised one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Звѣздꋋ̀ многосвѣ́тлꋋю, хрⷭ҇то́съ сл҃нце, на цр҃ко́внѣй высотѣ̀ положи́ тѧ кѷрі́лле, лꋋча́ми ᲂу҆че́нїй сщ҃енныхъ, ѡ҆зарѧ́юща сердца̀ вѣ́рнѡ соверша́ющихъ твою̀ свѣтоно́снꋋю па́мѧть прпⷣбне.
items.english_text: *March 19: Holy Martyrs Chrysanthus and Daria*[^286]

provenance.verbatim_source: *March 19: Holy Martyrs Chrysanthus and Daria*[^286]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having received the illumination of divine knowledge, thou didst enlighten the eyes of thy heart, O most wise one, and didst sensibly drive away the darkness of delusion, and didst confess Christ, the Lord of all, Who assumed flesh; whence, being strengthened by the power of the Spirit, O Chrysanthus, thou wast shown to be above tortures, O all-praised one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 1:* Having received the illumination of divine knowledge, thou didst enlighten the eyes of thy heart, O most wise one, and didst sensibly drive away the darkness of delusion, and didst confess Christ, the Lord of all, Who assumed flesh; whence, being strengthened by the power of the Spirit, O Chrysanthus, thou wast shown to be above tortures, O all-praised one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дствꋋющее бж҃твенныхъ добродѣ́телей, пречи́стаѧ бцⷣе, срⷭ҇це моѐ, покажѝ дв҃о плодоно́сно: ꙗ҆́же ѿ непло́дове ро́ждшаѧсѧ, во́лею всѧ̑ претворѧ́ющагѡ манове́нїемъ, да тѧ̀ пою̀ всепѣ́тꋋю.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The weapons of delusion and the burning fires of sensual pleasure thou didst account as a spider's web; and having been placed in a dark prison, thou wast illuminated with divine radiance, and filled with spiritual fragrance while standing in the midst of the stench...[^287] stench; and as a most excellent adorner of the bride, thou didst bring unto Christ an immaculate bride who had sought to defile thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 2:* The weapons of delusion and the burning fires of sensual pleasure thou didst account as a spider's web; and having been placed in a dark prison, thou wast illuminated with divine radiance, and filled with spiritual fragrance while standing in the midst of the stench...[^287]
...stench; and as a most excellent adorner of the bride, thou didst bring unto Christ an immaculate bride who had sought to defile thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: да. и҆ приве́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ невѣстокраси́тель всеизрѧ́днѣйшїй, * хрⷭ҇тꋋ невѣ́стꋋ непоро́чнꋋ, * ѡ҆скверни́ти тѧ̀ тща́щꋋюсѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Wounded with the sweetest love of the Creator, thou didst turn away completely from the delusion of godlessness, and didst enter within the divine bridal chamber, betrothed unto Christ through many bodily torments, O Daria of great renown, divine receptacle of the Spirit, adornment of martyrs, and beauty of virgins.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 3:* Wounded with the sweetest love of the Creator, thou didst turn away completely from the delusion of godlessness, and didst enter within the divine bridal chamber, betrothed unto Christ through many bodily torments, O Daria of great renown, divine receptacle of the Spirit, adornment of martyrs, and beauty of virgins.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆язви́вшисѧ раче́нїемъ * сладча́йшымъ зижди́телѧ, * пре́лести безбо́жїа до конца̀ ᲂу҆клони́ласѧ є҆сѝ: * и҆ черто́га бж҃твеннагѡ вмѣсти́ласѧ є҆сѝ вну́трь, * ᲂу҆невѣ́стившисѧ хрⷭ҇тꋋ * мꋋче́нїи мно́гими тѣлесѐ, * да́рїа великоимени́таѧ, * бж҃е́ственное прїѧ́телище дх҃а, * страда́льцевъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе, * и҆ дѣ́въ ᲂу҆краше́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion, the same Tone and Podoben:* The weakness and palsy of my soul do thou transform into strength and power, O Virgin, all-immaculate Mother, that in fear and love I may perform and work the ordinances of Christ; so that I may escape the intolerable fire, and through thee receive heavenly inheritance and unending life, ever rejoicing.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion, the same Tone and Podoben:* The weakness and palsy of my soul do thou transform into strength and power, O Virgin, all-immaculate Mother, that in fear and love I may perform and work the ordinances of Christ; so that I may escape the intolerable fire, and through thee receive heavenly inheritance and unending life, ever rejoicing.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for the good things Thou didst do for them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for the good things Thou didst do for them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Тѧ̀ златоза́рный мꋋ́ченикѡвъ цвѣ́тъ почита́ю. Кѵ́ръ і҆ѡ́сифъ. гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: Having traversed the Red Sea's deep with dry feet, ancient Israel of old, by the crosswise stretched hands of Moses, conquered Amalek's power in the wilderness.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having traversed the Red Sea's deep with dry feet, ancient Israel of old, by the crosswise stretched hands of Moses, conquered Amalek's power in the wilderness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мо́рѧ чермнꋋ́ю пꋋчи́нꋋ, невла́жными стопа́ми, дре́вній пѣшеше́ствовавъ і҆и҃ль, крⷭ҇тоѡбра́зными мѡѷсе́овыма рꋋка́ма, а҆мали́ковꋋ си́лꋋ въ пꋋсты́ни побѣди́лъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with a crown shining more brightly than gold, O martyr, and radiant with the beauties of martyrdom, thou dost stand before the Master, praying for us who honor thee, O worthy of honor.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Adorned with a crown shining more brightly than gold, O martyr, and radiant with the beauties of martyrdom, thou dost stand before the Master, praying for us who honor thee, O worthy of honor.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Вѣнце́мъ па́че зла́та сїѧ́ющимъ, мꋋ́нче ᲂу҆краша́емь: и҆ мꋋче́нїѧ сїѧ́ѧ добро́тами, влⷣцѣ предстои́ши ѡ҆ на́съ молѧ́сѧ, тѧ̀ чтꋋ́щихъ досточꋋ́дне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast wounded with the sweet desire of thy Creator, O martyr; and having despised the fair things of the world, thou didst give the whole strength of thy heart, O Chrysanthus, fervently unto Him Whom thou didst desire.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast wounded with the sweet desire of thy Creator, O martyr; and having despised the fair things of the world, thou didst give the whole strength of thy heart, O Chrysanthus, fervently unto Him Whom thou didst desire.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆язви́лсѧ є҆сѝ сла́дкимъ жела́нїемъ, мꋋ́чениче зижди́телѧ твоегѡ̀, и҆ кра̑снаѧ мі́ра презрѣ́въ, си́лꋋ всю̀ пода́лъ є҆сѝ твоегѡ̀ се́рдца хрѷса́нѳе, къ жела́емомꋋ тѝ ᲂу҆се́рднѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Armed with faith, thou didst cast down the manifold-wily one who sought, O martyr, to entice thee by womanly pleasure; and thou becamest a pure vessel of purity, O Chrysanthus.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Armed with faith, thou didst cast down the manifold-wily one who sought, O martyr, to entice thee by womanly pleasure; and thou becamest a pure vessel of purity, O Chrysanthus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́рою воѡрꋋжи́сѧ, низложи́лъ є҆сѝ многоко́зненнаго, тебѣ̀ прило́жшаго мꋋ́нче, же́нскою сла́стїю прельсти́ти. и҆ чистоты̀ чи́стенъ сосꋋ́дъ хрѷса́нѳе бы́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Inaccessible by divine nature, He appeared accessible unto me, having taken flesh from thee, O Virgin; Whom Daria desiring, patiently suffered, and was led unto Him as a bride.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Inaccessible by divine nature, He appeared accessible unto me, having taken flesh from thee, O Virgin; Whom Daria desiring, patiently suffered, and was led unto Him as a bride.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Весели́тсѧ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ це́рковь твоѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, зовꋋ́щи: ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость гдⷭ҇и, и҆ прибѣ́жище и҆ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: Thou art my strength, O Lord, and my refuge and my firm support.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: Thou art my strength, O Lord, and my refuge and my firm support.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Зла́то и҆скꋋ́шено, мꋋче́нїй ѻ҆гне́мъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ: цр҃кихъ хрѷса́нѳе, носѧ̀ страда́нїй и҆зображе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like gold tested by the fire of torments wast thou, O Chrysanthus, bearing the image of the King's sufferings.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Like gold tested by the fire of torments wast thou, O Chrysanthus, bearing the image of the King's sufferings.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Рито́рѡвъ ѡ҆ста́вль глꋋмле́нїе, плени́цами ᲂу҆лови́лсѧ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆чени́кѡвъ хрѷса́нѳе, пре́жде тебѐ ᲂу҆мꋋ́дрившагѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having abandoned the vain rhetoric of the rhetoricians, thou wast captured by the cords of the disciples of Him Who beforehand made thee wise, O Chrysanthus.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having abandoned the vain rhetoric of the rhetoricians, thou wast captured by the cords of the disciples of Him Who beforehand made thee wise, O Chrysanthus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Повину́ласѧ є҆сѝ рачи́телю, невѣстово́дѧщемꋋ тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тꋋ всемꋋ́драѧ: честны́ѧ ра́ди вѣ́ры, рачи́телѧ плотска́го ѡ҆ста́вльши.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst obey thy lover who betrothed thee unto Christ, O all-wise one, having abandoned a carnal lover for the sake of the honorable faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou didst obey thy lover who betrothed thee unto Christ, O all-wise one, having abandoned a carnal lover for the sake of the honorable faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Jesus, Who was born in the flesh from thy womb, O pure Virgin, betroths unto Himself Daria as a pure bride and martyr.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Jesus, Who was born in the flesh from thy womb, O pure Virgin, betroths unto Himself Daria as a pure bride and martyr.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пло́тїю рожде́йсѧ и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀ дв҃о і҆и҃съ чи́стаѧ, невѣ́стꋋ чи́стꋋ мꋋ́ченицꋋ себѣ̀, да́рїю ѡ҆брꋋча́етъ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Beholding the beauty of thy virginity" (Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства):* Thou didst desire the most beautiful beauty, and didst surpass visible beauties; and by thy truly golden words, O blessed Chrysanthus, thou didst lead unto Christ the glorious Daria, who endured sufferings and put the tormentor to shame; with her remember all of us who celebrate your memory in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Beholding the beauty of thy virginity" (Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства):*
Thou didst desire the most beautiful beauty, and didst surpass visible beauties; and by thy truly golden words, O blessed Chrysanthus, thou didst lead unto Christ the glorious Daria, who endured sufferings and put the tormentor to shame; with her remember all of us who celebrate your memory in faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства:
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Incomprehensible and past finding out, O Sovereign Lady joyful in God, is the dread divine mystery wrought in thee; for having conceived the Uncircumscribed One, thou didst bear Him clothed in flesh from thy most pure blood; Whom do thou ever implore, O pure one, as thy Son, that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Incomprehensible and past finding out, O Sovereign Lady joyful in God, is the dread divine mystery wrought in thee; for having conceived the Uncircumscribed One, thou didst bear Him clothed in flesh from thy most pure blood; Whom do thou ever implore, O pure one, as thy Son, that our souls may be saved.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Краснѣ́йшꋋю добро́тꋋ возжела́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ ви́димыѧ добро́ты прете́клъ є҆сѝ: и҆ приве́лъ хрⷭ҇тꋋ, златы́ми вои́стиннꋋ словесы̀ твои́ми, хрѷса́нѳе блаже́нне, да́рїю сла́внꋋю, страда́нїа претерпѣ́вшꋋю, и҆ томи́телѧ посра́млшꋋю. съ не́юже всѧ̑ ны̀ помина́й, вѣ́рою соверша́ющихъ па́мѧть ва́шꋋ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* An ignominious death by crucifixion didst Thou willingly endure, O compassionate One; and she who bore Thee, O Christ, was wounded beholding Thee. Through her supplications, for the compassion of Thy mercy, O only all-good Lord and Lover of mankind, have compassion and save the world, O Thou Who takest away the sins of the world.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stavrotheotokion:* An ignominious death by crucifixion didst Thou willingly endure, O compassionate One; and she who bore Thee, O Christ, was wounded beholding Thee. Through her supplications, for the compassion of Thy mercy, O only all-good Lord and Lover of mankind, have compassion and save the world, O Thou Who takest away the sins of the world.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the Church stood in her order, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the Church stood in her order, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Недомы́сленно и҆ непостижи́мо є҆́сть влⷣчце бг҃ора́дованнаѧ, є҆́же содѣ́ланное ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ стра́шное бж҃їе та́инство: и҆́бо неѡпи́саннаго заче́нши родила̀ є҆сѝ, пло́тїю ѡ҆бложе́на ѿ пречи́стыхъ крове́й твои́хъ: є҆го́же всегда̀ чтⷭ҇аѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ сн҃а твоего̀ молѝ, спасти́сѧ дꋋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The flashing beams of the Spirit, entering thy pure heart, made thee wholly radiant, O martyr, as thou didst fervently cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The flashing beams of the Spirit, entering thy pure heart, made thee wholly radiant, O martyr, as thou didst fervently cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With an incorruptible robe woven of divine goodness from on high did the Creator clothe thee, who didst preserve thy body blameless, O blessed one, and crowned thee as a victor.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With an incorruptible robe woven of divine goodness from on high did the Creator clothe thee, who didst preserve thy body blameless, O blessed one, and crowned thee as a victor.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Поно́снꋋю ще́дре сме́рть, въ распѧ́тїи во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: тебѐ же ро́ждшаѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ зрѧ́щи ᲂу҆ѧзвля́шесѧ. є҆ѧ́же мольба́ми за милосе́рдїе ми́лости твоеѧ̀, є҆ди́не пребл҃гі́й человѣколю́бче гдⷭ҇и, ᲂу҆ще́дри, и҆ спасѝ мі́ръ, взе́млѧй мі́ра грѣхѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By nobility of heart thou didst shake off bodily pleasures, enjoying the incomparable divine beauty; and rejoicing...[^288] thou didst accomplish the contest of thy martyrdom.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* By nobility of heart thou didst shake off bodily pleasures, enjoying the incomparable divine beauty; and rejoicing...[^288]
...thou didst accomplish the contest of thy martyrdom.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: соверши́лъ є҆сѝ мꋋче́нїа твоегѡ̀ по́двигъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast deified by participation in deifying union, O passion-bearer; and rejoicing, thou didst take up thine abode in the heavenly bridal chambers, as an immaculate bride of the Master of creation.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast deified by participation in deifying union, O passion-bearer; and rejoicing, thou didst take up thine abode in the heavenly bridal chambers, as an immaculate bride of the Master of creation.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆божи́ласѧ є҆сѝ по прича́стїю страстоно́сице, бготво́рнагѡ соедине́нїа: и҆ въ нб҃ныѧ всели́ласѧ є҆сѝ черто́ги ра́дꋋющисѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ непоро́чнаѧ невѣ́ста бл҃ки тва́ри.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having preserved thee as a Virgin after childbearing even as before childbearing, O all-pure one, the Incomprehensible One was incarnate of thee, bringing the martyr Daria unto Himself as a bride.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having preserved thee as a Virgin after childbearing even as before childbearing, O all-pure one, the Incomprehensible One was incarnate of thee, bringing the martyr Daria unto Himself as a bride.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as light, a holy light turning from gloomy ignorance those who hymn Thee in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as light, a holy light turning from gloomy ignorance those who hymn Thee in faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Соблю́дъ тѧ̀ дв҃ꋋ ꙗ҆́кѡ пре́жде ржⷭ҇тва, по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ пречт҃аѧ: и҆з̾ тебѐ воплоти́сѧ недомы́сленный, да́рїю мꋋ́ченицꋋ невѣ́стꋋ себѣ̀ приводѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having thy mind cleansed from material things, O blessed one, thou didst destroy the malice of the enemy, O passion-bearer.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having thy mind cleansed from material things, O blessed one, thou didst destroy the malice of the enemy, O passion-bearer.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become a most sacred lover of purity, thou didst transform the maiden's fiery love unto the Lord, O all-praised one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having become a most sacred lover of purity, thou didst transform the maiden's fiery love unto the Lord, O all-praised one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ гдⷭ҇и мо́й свѣ́тъ въ мі́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тъ ст҃ы́й, ѡ҆браща́ѧй и҆з̾ мра́чна невѣ́дѣнїѧ вѣ́рою воспѣва́ющыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the tormentor cast down and trampled underfoot, with a joyful mind, O most blessed one, thou didst magnify the Master.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Beholding the tormentor cast down and trampled underfoot, with a joyful mind, O most blessed one, thou didst magnify the Master.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чи́щенъ ᲂу҆́мъ ѿ ве́щныхъ тво́й, блаже́нне, ѕло́бꋋ вра́жїю, срⷭ҇тоно́сче разори́лъ є҆сѝ блаже́нне.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Who can tell thy mystery, O all-pure one? For beyond mind and word thou didst bear God the Word, two-fold in nature.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Who can tell thy mystery, O all-pure one? For beyond mind and word thou didst bear God the Word, two-fold in nature.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Чистоты̀ рачи́тель бы́въ сщ҃еннѣйшїй, претвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѣвы ѻ҆гнепла́мнꋋю любо́вь, ко гдⷭ҇ꋋ, прехва́лне.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пове́ржена зрѧ̀, и҆ нога́ми спопира́ема мꋋчи́телѧ: ра́дованною мы́слїю, бл҃гꋋ пребл҃же́нне велича́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As thou didst hymn the Master of all, O ever-memorable one, light from heaven surrounded thee on all sides and illumined thee when shut up in the dark dungeon, O Chrysanthus.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As thou didst hymn the Master of all, O ever-memorable one, light from heaven surrounded thee on all sides and illumined thee when shut up in the dark dungeon, O Chrysanthus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Rome, having acquired thee, who art glorified by honorable martyrdom, like a golden star, O martyr, is adorned with thy contests and thy divine wonders, O Chrysanthus.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Rome, having acquired thee, who art glorified by honorable martyrdom, like a golden star, O martyr, is adorned with thy contests and thy divine wonders, O Chrysanthus.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Кто̀ мо́жетъ твоѐ сказа́ти та́инство, Ѽ всечи́стаѧ! бг҃а сло́ва, па́че ᲂу҆ма́ бо и҆ сло́ва, сꙋгꙋ́ба є҆стество́мъ родила̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having appeared fair, highly adorned, and most glorious unto the most beautiful Word, O virgin martyr Daria, thou wast heavenified through all kinds of bodily pains.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having appeared fair, highly adorned, and most glorious unto the most beautiful Word, O virgin martyr Daria, thou wast heavenified through all kinds of bodily pains.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a young child, the Virgin bore Thee, the pre-eternal Word, Whom maidens desiring, were led as brides after Thee through her, O King of all.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* As a young child, the Virgin bore Thee, the pre-eternal Word, Whom maidens desiring, were led as brides after Thee through her, O King of all.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пожрꋋ́ ти со гла́сомъ хвале́нїѧ гдⷭ҇и, цр҃ковь вопїе́тъ тѝ, ѿ бѣсо́вскїѧ кро́ве ѡ҆чи́щшисѧ, ра́ди ми́лости ѿ ре́бръ твои́хъ и҆сте́кшею кро́вїю.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* In the Persian furnace, the Abrahamic children, burned with love of piety rather than with flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* In the Persian furnace, the Abrahamic children, burned with love of piety rather than with flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пою́ща бл҃гꋋ всѣ́хъ приснопа́мѧтне, свѣ́тъ съ нб҃се всю́ду тѧ̀ ѡ҆крꋋжи́въ просвѣтѝ, заключе́на въ темнѣ́йшей храми́нѣ хрѷса́нѳе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A golden-appearing flower of the martyrs wast thou, and an assembly...[^289] of sufferers thou didst lead unto Christ by thy divine words and wonders, O martyr acceptable to God; with them we faithfully call thee blessed now.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* A golden-appearing flower of the martyrs wast thou, and an assembly...[^289]
...of sufferers thou didst lead unto Christ by thy divine words and wonders, O martyr acceptable to God; with them we faithfully call thee blessed now.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: бо́ръ же страда́льцевъ приве́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тꋋ, бж҃твенными словесы̀ твои́ми и҆ чꋋдесы̀, мꋋ́нче бгопрїѧ́тне. съ ни́миже вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ ны́нѣ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When thou wast shut up naked in a foul brothel, O blessed one, Jesus illumined thee with divine fragrances and light-bearing glory; Whom with a pure mind, O all-wise one, thou didst love.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* When thou wast shut up naked in a foul brothel, O blessed one, Jesus illumined thee with divine fragrances and light-bearing glory; Whom with a pure mind, O all-wise one, thou didst love.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Въ хлѣви́нѣ скве́рнѣй, затворе́на на́га тѧ̀ блаже́нне, бж҃твенными бл҃гово́нїи, сла́вою свѣтови́дною і҆и҃съ просвѣща́етъ: є҆го́же чи́стою мы́слїю всемꋋ́дре возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Christ sent a wild beast to be a guardian of thy virginity,[^290] manifestly driving away the harm of the impious, as thou didst sing, O all-praised one: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Christ sent a wild beast to be a guardian of thy virginity,[^290] manifestly driving away the harm of the impious, as thou didst sing, O all-praised one: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Звѣ́рѧ храни́телѧ тебѣ̀ дѣ́вства хрⷭ҇то́съ посла̀, па́гꋋбꋋ нечести́выхъ ѿгонѧ́ща ꙗ҆́вѣ, пѣснопою́щей тебѣ̀ всехва́льнаѧ: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By divine essence the Son is uncircumscribed, but in thy womb, O Virgin, He became circumscribed in flesh for our sake; blessed art Thou among women, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* By divine essence the Son is uncircumscribed, but in thy womb, O Virgin, He became circumscribed in flesh for our sake; blessed art Thou among women, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро[диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Daniel, stretching out his hands, stopped the mouths of the lions in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girt with virtue, quenched the power of the fire, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Daniel, stretching out his hands, stopped the mouths of the lions in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girt with virtue, quenched the power of the fire, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: По сꙋществꋋ̀ бж҃е́ственномꋋ сы́нъ неѡпи́санъ, въ нѣ́дрѣхъ твои́хъ дв҃о, бы́сть по на́мъ пло́тїю ѡ҆пи́сꙋемь: бл҃гослове́на ты̀ въ жена́хъ є҆сѝ пренепоро́чнаѧ влⷣчце.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With a firm mind, O blessed one, opposing the vainly-wise, thou didst endure bodily tearings; and being burned with torches, thou didst remain unconsumed, singing with the youths, O Chrysanthus: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With a firm mind, O blessed one, opposing the vainly-wise, thou didst endure bodily tearings; and being burned with torches, thou didst remain unconsumed, singing with the youths, O Chrysanthus: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with Christ's wisdom, thou didst put to shame the insolence of the foolish, and didst confound the mind of the deceiver who seduced Eve; having piously taken captive his weapon, O wise one, thou didst bring unto God a bride chosen for the sake of faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Adorned with Christ's wisdom, thou didst put to shame the insolence of the foolish, and didst confound the mind of the deceiver who seduced Eve; having piously taken captive his weapon, O wise one, thou didst bring unto God a bride chosen for the sake of faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Рꋋ́цѣ распросте́ръ данїи́лъ, львѡ́въ зїѧ̑нїѧ въ ро́вѣ затчѐ: ѻ҆́гненнꋋю же си́лꋋ ᲂу҆гаси́ша, добродѣ́телїю препоѧ́савшесѧ, бл҃гоче́стїѧ рачи́тели ѻ҆́троцы, взыва́юще: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By unity of soul ye escaped carnal union; ye were shown to be pure vessels of the Almighty, and were brought into the heavenly temple, O sufferers, crying unto Christ: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* By unity of soul ye escaped carnal union; ye were shown to be pure vessels of the Almighty, and were brought into the heavenly temple, O sufferers, crying unto Christ: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Тве́рдымъ блаже́нне по́мысломъ, проти́вѧсѧ сꋋемꋋ́дреномꋋ, строга̑нїѧ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ тѣле́снаѧ: и҆ свѣща́ми ѡ҆пала́емь, неѡпали́мъ пребы́лъ є҆сѝ, со ѻ҆́троки воспѣва́ѧ хрѷса́нѳе: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Restraining carnal passions with divine dew, Chrysanthus and Daria reduced the fire of torments to ashes with the dew of the Spirit; and they attained crowns of life, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Restraining carnal passions with divine dew, Chrysanthus and Daria reduced the fire of torments to ashes with the dew of the Spirit; and they attained crowns of life, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Премꋋ́дростїю ᲂу҆кра́шенъ хрⷭ҇то́вою, ѡ҆бꋋи́лъ є҆сѝ немоꙋ́дрыхъ шата́нїе: и҆ ᲂу҆́мъ льсти́вагѡ посрами́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆́ѵꋋ прельсти́вшагѡ: плѣни́въ бл҃гоче́стнѡ сегѡ̀ ѻ҆рꋋ́жїе мꋋ́дре, и҆ приве́лъ є҆сѝ невѣ́стꋋ бг҃ꋋ, и҆збра́ннꋋ вѣ́ры ра́ди.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Like a rose in the midst of worldly thorns, O most pure one, God found thee unspotted, and made His abode in thy pure womb, and filled the world with mystical fragrance, as it cries: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Like a rose in the midst of worldly thorns, O most pure one, God found thee unspotted, and made His abode in thy pure womb, and filled the world with mystical fragrance, as it cries: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆дине́нїемъ дꋋшѝ, плотска́гѡ и҆збѣжа́сте совѣкꋋпле́нїѧ: чи́стыѧ сосꋋ́ды вседержи́телѧ ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ, и҆ въ хра́мъ принесо́стесѧ нб҃ный страда́льцы, вопїю́ще хрⷭ҇тꋋ: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* A cornerstone was cut out without hands from thee, the unhewn mountain, O Virgin, even Christ, Who hath joined together the separated natures; therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God.
