provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* A cornerstone was cut out without hands from thee, the unhewn mountain, O Virgin, even Christ, Who hath joined together the separated natures; therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Росо́ю бж҃їею плотскі̑ѧ стра̑сти ᲂу҆держа́вше, ѻ҆́гнь и҆спепели́ша мꋋ́къ, хрѷса́нѳъ и҆ да́рїа росо́ю дх҃а. и҆ вѣнце́въ жи́зни ᲂу҆лꋋчи́ша пою́ще, бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O sacred...[^291] heralds of divine things, a divine army joined itself unto thee, having been delivered from vile delusion; and by the sword they were offered as blameless sacrifices, O martyrs, unto Him Who was sacrificed like a sheep for our sake.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* O sacred...[^291]
...heralds of divine things, a divine army joined itself unto thee, having been delivered from vile delusion; and by the sword they were offered as blameless sacrifices, O martyrs, unto Him Who was sacrificed like a sheep for our sake.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: сло́вцѣ бж҃твеннаѧ, бж҃твенное во́инство тебѣ̀ приложи́сѧ, ле́сти скве́рныѧ и҆зба́вльсѧ: и҆ мече́мъ непоро́чныѧ же́ртвы, на́съ ра́ди ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча́ти, мꋋ́нцы поже́ршемꋋсѧ, принесо́шасѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye appeared in the midst of wild beasts like lambs, O passion-bearers, preaching the divine incarnation of Him Who poured Himself out even unto flesh; and through sufferings ye divinely inherited a painless end.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ye appeared in the midst of wild beasts like lambs, O passion-bearers, preaching the divine incarnation of Him Who poured Himself out even unto flesh; and through sufferings ye divinely inherited a painless end.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ посредѝ ѕвѣре́й, ꙗ҆́коже а҆́гнцы страстоте́рпцы, воплоще́нїе проповѣ́дающе бж҃твенное, и҆злїѧ́вшагѡсѧ да́же и҆ до пло́ти. и҆ болѣ́знми неболѣ́зненнꋋю кончи́нꋋ, бж҃твеннѣ наслѣ́довасте.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Today every city and country brightly celebrates, the city of Rome calling together, setting forth your divine sufferings and struggles as an immaterial feast, O holy ones.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Today every city and country brightly celebrates, the city of Rome calling together, setting forth your divine sufferings and struggles as an immaterial feast, O holy ones.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Дне́сь свѣ́тлѡ пра́зднꋋетъ всѧ́къ гра́дъ же и҆ страна̀, ри́мъ созыва́ющи гра́дъ, бж҃е́ствєнныѧ стра̑сти и҆ боре́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ всечрежде́нїе невеще́ственное, предлага́ющи ва́съ ст҃і́и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye were taken up unto immeasurable glory, O martyr Chrysanthus and Daria; and crowned together, ye stand before the almighty Word, praying for us who ever call you blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ye were taken up unto immeasurable glory, O martyr Chrysanthus and Daria; and crowned together, ye stand before the almighty Word, praying for us who ever call you blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Взѧ́ти бы́сте къ безмѣ́рнѣй сла́вѣ, хрѷса́нѳе мꋋ́чениче и҆ да́рїа. и҆ вседержи́тельномꋋ сло́вꋋ, вѣнцено́сцы вкꋋ́пѣ предстои́тѐ, ѡ҆ на́съ молѧ́щесѧ, блажа́щихъ ва́съ всегда̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mind and heart tremble, contemplating thy childbearing that passes understanding, O Maiden; for thou didst bear in thy womb God the Word, Who delivers through thee from every distress those who honor thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Mind and heart tremble, contemplating thy childbearing that passes understanding, O Maiden; for thou didst bear in thy womb God the Word, Who delivers through thee from every distress those who honor thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о[ро́диченъ]:
items.english_text: *March 20: Venerable Fathers Slain at the Monastery of St. Sabbas*[^292]

provenance.verbatim_source: *March 20: Venerable Fathers Slain at the Monastery of St. Sabbas*[^292]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ к҃ де́нь. Преподо́бныхъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ, во ѻ҆би́тели ст҃а́гѡ са́ввы ᲂу҆бїе́нныхъ. Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Cleaving to the utmost of desires unto the end, O venerable ones, ye accounted all worldly beauties as refuse; and by vigil and prayers, by rain and scorching heat, ye acquired the things that abide alone; having dwelt together in unity, by grace ye were shown to be fellow-citizens with the angels.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 1:* Cleaving to the utmost of desires unto the end, O venerable ones, ye accounted all worldly beauties as refuse; and by vigil and prayers, by rain and scorching heat, ye acquired the things that abide alone; having dwelt together in unity, by grace ye were shown to be fellow-citizens with the angels.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Жела́ній кра́йнѣйшемꋋ * до конца̀ прилѣпи́вше, * жите́йскїа красоты̀ прпⷣбнїи * ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆ме́ты всѧ̑ вмѣни́сте. * и҆ є҆ди́на пребыва́ющаѧ, * бдѣ́нїемъ и҆ мл҃твами, * дожде́мъ же и҆ ва́ромъ стѧжа́сте. * є҆динножи́теле вкꋋ́пѣ бы́вше, * согра́ждане а҆́гглѡмъ ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Beaten with cudgels, pelted with stones, and cut to pieces with weapons, ye did not break the unity of mind, O martyrs, bound by love and brotherly desire; but being put to death together and cut limb from limb, O passion-bearers, ye were laid upon the divine table as blameless sacrifices.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sticheron 2:* Beaten with cudgels, pelted with stones, and cut to pieces with weapons, ye did not break the unity of mind, O martyrs, bound by love and brotherly desire; but being put to death together and cut limb from limb, O passion-bearers, ye were laid upon the divine table as blameless sacrifices.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Дреко́лїемъ бїе́ми, * и҆ ка́менїемъ намета́еми, * и҆ ѡ҆рꋋ́жїи разсѣка́еми: * є҆диномо́слїѧ не разрꋋши́сте мꋋ́нцы, * любо́вїю свѧза́нїи * и҆ жела́нїемъ бра́тскимъ: * но вкꋋ́пѣ ᲂу҆мерщвлѧ́еми, * и҆ разсѣка́еми на ᲂу҆́ды страстоте́рпцы, * на трапе́зѣ положи́стесѧ бж҃твеннѣй, * ꙗ҆́кѡ же́ртвы непоро́чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Exhausted by fire and suffocated by strangling, ye surrendered your souls as blameless sacrifices, O glorious martyrs, together into His hands; and ye were joined to the ranks of the bodiless powers, and inherited everlasting glory...[^293] which do ye unceasingly pray that we who praise you may partake of.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 3:* Exhausted by fire and suffocated by strangling, ye surrendered your souls as blameless sacrifices, O glorious martyrs, together into His hands; and ye were joined to the ranks of the bodiless powers, and inherited everlasting glory...[^293]
...which do ye unceasingly pray that we who praise you may partake of.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: є҆́йже прича́ститисѧ ва́съ восхва́лѧщымъ, * непреста́ннѡ моли́теся.
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion, the same Tone and Podoben:* Choice repentance and saving medicine, O thou who didst bear God my Savior, and streams of tears, and meditation upon the dread and fearful hour and unbribable judgment, do thou grant me to escape through thy prayers, O Virgin, from trembling torment, and to obtain divine grace.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion, the same Tone and Podoben:* Choice repentance and saving medicine, O thou who didst bear God my Savior, and streams of tears, and meditation upon the dread and fearful hour and unbribable judgment, do thou grant me to escape through thy prayers, O Virgin, from trembling torment, and to obtain divine grace.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, the ewe-lamb and Thy Mother marveled, and cried aloud: What vision is this, O longed-for Son? Hath the disobedient and lawless assembly rendered these things unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many wonders? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, the ewe-lamb and Thy Mother marveled, and cried aloud: What vision is this, O longed-for Son? Hath the disobedient and lawless assembly rendered these things unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many wonders? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Пѣ́сньми сла́влю мꋋ́нки є҆динонра́вныѧ. Творе́нїе кѵ́ръ стефа́на сава́ита. гла́съ, и҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: A hymn let us send up, O ye people, unto our marvelous God, Who freed Israel from bondage, singing a song of victory and crying aloud: We sing unto Thee, the only Master!

provenance.verbatim_source: A hymn let us send up, O ye people, unto our marvelous God, Who freed Israel from bondage, singing a song of victory and crying aloud: We sing unto Thee, the only Master!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь возсле́мъ лю́дїе чꋋ́дномꋋ бг҃ꋋ на́шемꋋ, свободи́вшемꋋ і҆и҃лѧ ѿ рабо́ты, пѣ́снь побѣ́днꋋю пою́ще и҆ вопїю́ще, пои́мъ тебѣ̀ є҆ди́номꋋ влⷣцѣ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When I desire to praise in hymns the divinely-crowned multitude of Thy sacred martyrs, O Christ, grant me from heaven the light of understanding by their supplications, that I may sing a divinely-proclaimed song.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* When I desire to praise in hymns the divinely-crowned multitude of Thy sacred martyrs, O Christ, grant me from heaven the light of understanding by their supplications, that I may sing a divinely-proclaimed song.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́ньми бговѣнча́нное мно́жество, сщ҃енныхъ мꋋ́нкъ твои́хъ, жела́ющемꋋ похвали́ти, хрⷭ҇ѐ съ нб҃се пода́ждь ми свѣ́тъ ра́зꋋма си́хъ мольба́ми: да воспою̀ бговѣща́ннꋋю пѣ́снь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye cast away the filth of flesh and spirit, O exceedingly rich ones, having escaped the deadly pleasures of the world; and having lived a life equal to the angels, ye passed over unto the highest habitation.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ye cast away the filth of flesh and spirit, O exceedingly rich ones, having escaped the deadly pleasures of the world; and having lived a life equal to the angels, ye passed over unto the highest habitation.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Скве́рнꋋ ѡ҆верго́сте, пло́ти и҆ дх҃а пребога́тїи, мі́ра сме́ртоносныхъ сласте́й и҆збѣ́гше: равноа́гглное же житїѐ пожи́вше, въ вы́шнее преидо́сте жили́ще.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having manifestly guided your members and senses by the law of the Spirit, ye showed yourselves to be sacred temples of God, O God-bearing martyrs, for Christ took up His abode in you.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having manifestly guided your members and senses by the law of the Spirit, ye showed yourselves to be sacred temples of God, O God-bearing martyrs, for Christ took up His abode in you.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Зако́номъ дх҃а ꙗ҆́вѣ, ᲂу҆́ды ᲂу҆пра́вивше ва́шѧ и҆ чꋋ́вства, хра́мы сщ҃е́нны бг҃ꋋ показа́стесѧ, мꋋ́нци бгоно́снїи, въ ва́съ бо хрⷭ҇то́съ водвори́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having left corruptible wealth upon the earth, O holy ones, and having despised the fair things of life as a dream, having well-pleased Christ, ye have now received an unshakable kingdom.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having left corruptible wealth upon the earth, O holy ones, and having despised the fair things of life as a dream, having well-pleased Christ, ye have now received an unshakable kingdom.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Бога́тство тли́мое на землѝ ѡ҆ста́вльше ст҃і́и, и҆ кра̑снаѧ житїѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ со́нъ презрѣ́вше, хрⷭ҇тꋋ ᲂу҆годи́вше, недви́жимое црⷭ҇тво ннѣ̀ воспрїѧ́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown to be the spiritual ladder which Jacob, the chosen of God, beheld, through which by an ineffable word the Bodiless One came forth, having become flesh without change, beyond word, from thee, O Birthgiver of God.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown to be the spiritual ladder which Jacob, the chosen of God, beheld, through which by an ineffable word the Bodiless One came forth, having become flesh without change, beyond word, from thee, O Birthgiver of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord, Creator of the vault of heaven and Builder of the Church, do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, firm support of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord, Creator of the vault of heaven and Builder of the Church, do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, firm support of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Лѣ́ствица ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ мы́сленнаѧ, ю҆́же і҆а́кѡвъ ви́дѣ и҆збра́нный бж҃їй, и҆з̾ неѧ́же неизрече́ннымъ сло́вомъ про́йде безпло́тный, пло́ть непрело́жнѡ бы́въ, па́че сло́ва и҆з̾ тебѐ бцⷣе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having consecrated your whole life, O martyrs, blamelessly in truth unto all-seeing God, ye offered yourselves as divine holocausts...[^294] and received perfect crowns.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Having consecrated your whole life, O martyrs, blamelessly in truth unto all-seeing God, ye offered yourselves as divine holocausts...[^294]
...and received perfect crowns.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: ственна са́ми себѐ, и҆ соверше́нныѧ вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As true disciples of God-bearing Sabbas, having desired departure without delay, walking irreversibly along the sorrowful path, ye attained unto unending life.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As true disciples of God-bearing Sabbas, having desired departure without delay, walking irreversibly along the sorrowful path, ye attained unto unending life.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Са́ввы бгоно́снагѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆чени́цы и҆́скреннїи, є҆́же кромѣ̀ плѣ́цевъ возжелѣ́вше ѿше́ствїе: невозвра́тнѡ стезѐю приско́рбною ше́ствꋋюще, къ жи́зни достиго́сте безконе́чнѣй.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cultivated the seed, the word sown within you, O venerable ones, and having watered it abundantly with streams of tears, ye brought forth fruit, offering unto God a hundredfold ear of grain.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having cultivated the seed, the word sown within you, O venerable ones, and having watered it abundantly with streams of tears, ye brought forth fruit, offering unto God a hundredfold ear of grain.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро[диченъ]: гла́съ, и҆
items.slavonic_text: Воз̾дѣ́лавше сѣ́ма є҆́же въ ва́съ преподо́бнїи всѣ́ѧное сло́во, и҆ сле́зными то́ки ѻ҆би́льнѡ напои́вше, стори́чествꋋющій кла́съ бг҃ꋋ принесо́сте плодоноси́вше.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having dwelt bodily in the Virgin, O Lord, Thou didst appear unto men as it was fitting to behold Thee; and her Thou didst reveal as true Birthgiver of God and help of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having dwelt bodily in the Virgin, O Lord, Thou didst appear unto men as it was fitting to behold Thee; and her Thou didst reveal as true Birthgiver of God and help of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "That which was commanded mystically" (Повелѣ́нное та́иннѡ):*[^295] By self-control having mortified the fiery appearances and motions of passions, O hermits acceptable to God, following the footsteps of the only God Who created all things, as an acceptable sacrifice, living and consecrated, ye were offered by the slaughter of barbarian hands, being beaten, butchered, and violently cut down.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "That which was commanded mystically" (Повелѣ́нное та́иннѡ):*[^295]
By self-control having mortified the fiery appearances and motions of passions, O hermits acceptable to God, following the footsteps of the only God Who created all things, as an acceptable sacrifice, living and consecrated, ye were offered by the slaughter of barbarian hands, being beaten, butchered, and violently cut down.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Всели́сѧ въ дв҃ꋋ пло́тски гдⷭ҇и, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ человѣ́кѡмъ, ꙗ҆́коже подоба́ше зрѣ́ти тѧ̀. ю҆́же и҆ показа́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́стиннꋋю бцⷣꋋ, и҆ вѣ́рнымъ по́мощь, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* O thou joyful in God, pure and blessed one, for the tender mercy of the compassion of Him Who was born of thee, with the heavenly hosts and archangels and with all the bodiless ones, pray unceasingly for us, that He may grant us before the end pardon and cleansing of sins, and amendment of life, so that we may find mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* O thou joyful in God, pure and blessed one, for the tender mercy of the compassion of Him Who was born of thee, with the heavenly hosts and archangels and with all the bodiless ones, pray unceasingly for us, that He may grant us before the end pardon and cleansing of sins, and amendment of life, so that we may find mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Повелѣ́нное та́иннѡ:
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Ever protected, O Virgin, by the Cross of thy Son and God, we conquer demonic assaults and wiles, truly hymning thee as the true Birthgiver of God; and in love all generations call thee blessed, O all-pure one, even as thou didst foretell; therefore grant remission of our transgressions through thy prayers.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stavrotheotokion:* Ever protected, O Virgin, by the Cross of thy Son and God, we conquer demonic assaults and wiles, truly hymning thee as the true Birthgiver of God; and in love all generations call thee blessed, O all-pure one, even as thou didst foretell; therefore grant remission of our transgressions through thy prayers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Воздержа́нїемъ страсте́й, ѻ҆гнепла̑лныѧ ᲂу҆мертви́вше зри̑ки и҆ двиза́нїѧ, пꋋ́стинницы бгопрїѧ́тнїи послѣ́дꋋюще стопа́мъ всѧ̑ созда́вшемꋋ є҆ди́номꋋ бг҃ꋋ, ꙗ҆́коже прїѧ́тна же́ртва жива̀ и҆ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нна, принесо́стеся заколе́нїемъ рꋋ́къ ва́рварскихъ, бїе́ми, заклала́еми, и҆ нꋋ́жнѡ пресѣка́еми.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou didst mount upon horses, even Thine apostles, O Lord, and didst take their reins into Thy hands; and Thy riding became salvation unto those who sing in faith: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou didst mount upon horses, even Thine apostles, O Lord, and didst take their reins into Thy hands; and Thy riding became salvation unto those who sing in faith: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the invincible martyrs pining away in the waterless wilderness, yet adorned with various virtues, the enemy was fiercely inflamed, covered with envy, and prepared himself for battle.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Beholding the invincible martyrs pining away in the waterless wilderness, yet adorned with various virtues, the enemy was fiercely inflamed, covered with envy, and prepared himself for battle.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃горадо́ваннаѧ чи́стаѧ бл҃гослове́ннаѧ, за млⷭ҇рдїе щедро́тъ и҆з̾ тебѐ ро́ждшагосѧ, съ вы́шними си́лами и҆ а҆рха́гглами, и҆ со всѣ́ми безпло́тными, ѡ҆ на́съ молѝ непреста́ннѡ, да́ти на́мъ пре́жде конца̀ проще́нїе, и҆ ѡ҆чище́нїе грѣхѡ́въ, и҆ житїѧ̀ и҆справле́нїе: ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѡ҆брѧ́щемъ млⷭ҇ть.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having rooted deceit in his disciples, the crafty serpent stirred up the barbarian tribes unto mutual slaughter, by whom he also sought to drive the venerable ones out of the wilderness; fiercely...[^296] fiercely seizing those roundabout, even as he desired; yet he was not able to drive away these invincible, righteous combatants; and being vanquished invisibly, he wretchedly writhed in scheming.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Having rooted deceit in his disciples, the crafty serpent stirred up the barbarian tribes unto mutual slaughter, by whom he also sought to drive the venerable ones out of the wilderness; fiercely...[^296]
...fiercely seizing those roundabout, even as he desired; yet he was not able to drive away these invincible, righteous combatants; and being vanquished invisibly, he wretchedly writhed in scheming.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сверѣ́пѡ и҆́же ѡ҆кре́стныхъ ѡ҆б̾е́мъ, ꙗ҆́коже возжела̀: ѿгна́ти ᲂу҆́бѡ сїѧ̑ не возмо́же, непобѣди́мыхъ, пра́ведныхъ сопротивоборе́цъ. побѣжде́нъ же бы́въ неви́димѡ, ѡ҆коѧбле́ннѣ коврꋋ́жисѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Full of poison and frenzy, the originator of evil rushed forward with armed men, and like a wild beast attacked the blessed ones, and by intolerable wounds poured forth streams of blood.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Full of poison and frenzy, the originator of evil rushed forward with armed men, and like a wild beast attacked the blessed ones, and by intolerable wounds poured forth streams of blood.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́да и҆ неи́стовства и҆спо́лненъ ᲂу҆стреми́сѧ со ѻ҆рꋋ́жники ѕлонача́лникъ, ѕвѣрови́днѡ же блаже́ннымъ натечѐ, и҆ ра́нами нестерпи́мыми кро́вныѧ пото́ки и҆злїѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* They who fixed their hopes upon earthly things demanded fleeting substance, the treasures of corruptible gold; but the noble ones, having placed their hope upon God, cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* They who fixed their hopes upon earthly things demanded fleeting substance, the treasures of corruptible gold; but the noble ones, having placed their hope upon God, cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Текꋋ́щагѡ и҆стѧзова́хꋋ веще́ства, зла́та тлѣ́ннагѡ сокро́вища, и҆́же на землѝ ᲂу҆подо́бнїа ᲂу҆твержда́вшїи: до́блїи же на бг҃а поло́жше ᲂу҆пова́нїа, вопїѧ́хꋋ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like wild beasts they mercilessly struck the venerable ones with cudgels and swords and stones, commanding them to tell who their elders were; but they all remained confirmed in the law of love.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Like wild beasts they mercilessly struck the venerable ones with cudgels and swords and stones, commanding them to tell who their elders were; but they all remained confirmed in the law of love.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже ѕвѣ́рїе дреко́лми неми́лостивнѡ, и҆ мечѝ преподо́бныхъ, и҆ ка́менїемъ ᲂу҆ража́хꋋ, своѧ̑ старѣ́йшины сказа́ти велѧ́ще: но пребыва́хꋋ всѝ зако́номъ любвѐ ᲂу҆твержда́еми.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mother of God, thou art the adornment of the apostles, the firm support of the holy martyrs, and the boast and salvation of the venerable, who faithfully and sweetly sing: Glory to Thy power!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Mother of God, thou art the adornment of the apostles, the firm support of the holy martyrs, and the boast and salvation of the venerable, who faithfully and sweetly sing: Glory to Thy power!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O Light never-setting, and an alien darkness hath covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my paths, I pray.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O Light never-setting, and an alien darkness hath covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my paths, I pray.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о и҆ мт҃и ты̀ а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе, и҆ мꋋ́нкѡвъ сты́хъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, и҆ прпⷣбныхъ похвала́ же и҆ спасенїе, вѣ́рнѡ сладкопою́щихъ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having learned the bond of perfection, love, O Savior, and being instructed by Thee, the venerable ones laid down their souls for their friends, imitating Thy voluntary passions that surpass the comprehension of men.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having learned the bond of perfection, love, O Savior, and being instructed by Thee, the venerable ones laid down their souls for their friends, imitating Thy voluntary passions that surpass the comprehension of men.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beyond nature, O Christ, Who wast willingly born in the flesh, by Thy command they were shown to be stronger than death; for having conformed themselves to Thy law, the godly-wise zealously strove to die praise-worthily for their friends.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Beyond nature, O Christ, Who wast willingly born in the flesh, by Thy command they were shown to be stronger than death; for having conformed themselves to Thy law, the godly-wise zealously strove to die praise-worthily for their friends.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Вскꋋ́ю мѧ̀ ѿри́нꋋлъ є҆сѝ, ѿ лица̀ твоегѡ̀ свѣ́те незаходи́мый, и҆ покры́ла мѧ̀ є҆́сть чꋋжда́ѧ тма̀ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаго: но ѡ҆брати́ мѧ, и҆ къ свѣ́тꋋ за́повѣдей твои́хъ, пꋋти̑ моѧ̑ напра́ви молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having sprinkled their souls with the spiritual hyssop of baptism, ye were straightway sprinkled with your own blood, O venerable ones; and tested like gold in the surging of the fire, ye became an acceptable and sweet-smelling sacrifice unto God.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having sprinkled their souls with the spiritual hyssop of baptism, ye were straightway sprinkled with your own blood, O venerable ones; and tested like gold in the surging of the fire, ye became an acceptable and sweet-smelling sacrifice unto God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Наꙋчи́вшесѧ любвѐ сп҃се, сою́зꋋ соверше́нїѧ прпⷣбнїи, и҆ наказа́ни тобо́ю, дꋋ́шы положи́ша по свои́хъ дрꋋзѣ́хъ, твои́мъ па́че человѣ́кѡвъ во́лнымъ стрт҃емъ подо́бѧщесѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having acquired maternal boldness toward thy Son, O all-pure one, do not despise, we pray, the kindred care for us; for we Christians put thee forward alone unto the Master as a merciful propitiation.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having acquired maternal boldness toward thy Son, O all-pure one, do not despise, we pray, the kindred care for us; for we Christians put thee forward alone unto the Master as a merciful propitiation.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́ми па́че є҆стества̀, пло́тїю во́лею рожде́йсѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ, повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ сме́рти ꙗ҆ви́шасѧ держа́внѣе: ꙗ҆́ко твои̑мъ соста́влшесѧ зако́номъ, ᲂу҆мре́ти по дрꋋзѣ́хъ бл҃гохва́лнѡ бгомоꙋ́дрїи тща́хꋋсѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Unto the Lord Who is able to save me, out of the deep of sins I cried, and from corruption He brought up my life, for He is the Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Unto the Lord Who is able to save me, out of the deep of sins I cried, and from corruption He brought up my life, for He is the Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆кропи́вше ѵ҆ссѡ́помъ креще́нїѧ мы́сленнымъ дꋋ́шы, ва́шими же а҆́бїе ѡ҆кропи́стесѧ кровмѝ прпⷣбнїи. во стремле́нїи же ѻ҆гнѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ зла́то и҆скꋋси́вшесѧ, прїѧ́тна бы́сте же́ртва бл҃гово́нна бг҃ꋋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Of the threats...[^297] of the barbarians the favorites of Christ feared not; for by unceasing contemplation they set their life before death.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Of the threats...[^297]
...of the barbarians the favorites of Christ feared not; for by unceasing contemplation they set their life before death.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Преще́нїй ва́рварскихъ не ᲂу҆боѧ́шасѧ, ᲂу҆го́дницы хв҃ы: житїѐ бо непреста́ннымъ поꙋче́нїемъ сме́ртнымъ предста́виша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thinking to grow rich, the impious impoverishers unjustly tormented them, who had cast away corruptible things, and acquired the incorruptible.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thinking to grow rich, the impious impoverishers unjustly tormented them, who had cast away corruptible things, and acquired the incorruptible.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мнѧ́ще бога́тѣти нищетꙋ́тели, нечести́вїи непра́днѡ мꋋ́чахꋋ, ꙗ҆́же тлѣ̑ннаѧ ᲂу҆́бѡ пове́ргшымъ, стѧжа́вшымъ же нетлѣ̑ннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Clothed with invincible power, the martyrs of Christ conquered the spiritual deceivers and the insolence of the barbarians.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Clothed with invincible power, the martyrs of Christ conquered the spiritual deceivers and the insolence of the barbarians.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою непобѣди́мою ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвшесѧ, хрⷭ҇то́вы страда́льцы, побѣди́ша мы́сленныѧ ле́стцы, и҆ варва́рскаѧ шата́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As upon a light cloud the reigning Lord came unto thee, O all-immaculate one, to cast down the handmade idols of Egypt.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* As upon a light cloud the reigning Lord came unto thee, O all-immaculate one, to cast down the handmade idols of Egypt.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о[ро́диченъ]:
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):* Despising the enjoyment of earthly and corruptible things, O most blessed ones, ye manifestly chose the wilderness life, and hated the fair things of the world and temporary food; whence ye were accounted worthy of the kingdom of heaven, rejoicing with the choirs of martyrs and fasters; therefore honoring your memory, we diligently cry aloud unto you: Deliver us from perils, O fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
Despising the enjoyment of earthly and corruptible things, O most blessed ones, ye manifestly chose the wilderness life, and hated the fair things of the world and temporary food; whence ye were accounted worthy of the kingdom of heaven, rejoicing with the choirs of martyrs and fasters; therefore honoring your memory, we diligently cry aloud unto you: Deliver us from perils, O fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ на ѡ҆́блацѣ ле́гцѣмъ прїи́де на тѧ̀, ца́рствꋋѧй гдⷭ҇ь, низложи́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, є҆гѵ́петскаѧ рꋋкотворе́нїа.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Having quenched the all-destructive power of the Chaldean furnace by the figure of the angel who descended, the youths cried unto the Creator: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Having quenched the all-destructive power of the Chaldean furnace by the figure of the angel who descended, the youths cried unto the Creator: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The battles of the opposing hosts, visible and invisible, grew faint together, beholding the martyrs in wounds faithfully hymning: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The battles of the opposing hosts, visible and invisible, grew faint together, beholding the martyrs in wounds faithfully hymning: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Земны́хъ и҆ тлѣ́нныхъ наслажде́нїе презрѣ́вше, ꙗ҆́вѣ преблаже́ннїи: пꋋсты́нное житїѐ и҆зво́ливше, мі́ра же краснѣ́йшее, и҆ пи́щи вре́менныѧ возненави́дѣвше: ѿню́дꋋже сподо́бистесѧ нбⷭ҇нагѡ црⷭ҇твїа, с̾ ли́ки мꋋ́ченикъ и҆ по́стникъ веселѧ́щесѧ. тѣ́мже чтꋋ́ще па́мѧть ва́шꋋ, вопїе́мъ ва́мъ прилѣ́жнѡ: ѿ бѣ́дъ на́съ ѻ҆тцы̀ и҆зба́вите.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Betrothed unto Thee, O Christ, and wounded with desire for Thee, they loved the only One Who is; having cast away family and fatherland and wealth, they fled unto Thee, O Deliverer, God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Betrothed unto Thee, O Christ, and wounded with desire for Thee, they loved the only One Who is; having cast away family and fatherland and wealth, they fled unto Thee, O Deliverer, God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The foul murder of the barbarians did not turn Thy lovers away, O Christ, from wilderness worship of God; for they feared not those who kill the body, keeping Thy commandments as an unforgotten renewal.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The foul murder of the barbarians did not turn Thy lovers away, O Christ, from wilderness worship of God; for they feared not those who kill the body, keeping Thy commandments as an unforgotten renewal.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Халде́йскїа пе́щи, всепа́гꋋбнꋋю си́лꋋ ᲂу҆гаси́вше, ѡ҆́бразомъ а҆́ггла снизше́дшагѡ, зижди́телю ю҆́ношы взыва́хꋋ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ и҆ хва́лный бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having turned their desire from the world unto Thee, O Christ, and armed their wrath only against sin, having embraced all-wise thought, Thy favorites well-pleased Thee, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having turned their desire from the world unto Thee, O Christ, and armed their wrath only against sin, having embraced all-wise thought, Thy favorites well-pleased Thee, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: И҆знемого́ша вкꋋ́пѣ бра̑ни проти́вныхъ полкѡ́въ, ви́димыхъ и҆ неви́димыхъ, въ ра́нахъ зрѧ́ще, мꋋ́ченики вѣ́сносло́вѧщыѧ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ и҆ хва́лный бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having received from God the divinely-written law within the tablets of their hearts, O blessed ones, ye martyrs proclaim the one God in Trinity, crying unto Him: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having received from God the divinely-written law within the tablets of their hearts, O blessed ones, ye martyrs proclaim the one God in Trinity, crying unto Him: Blessed art Thou and praised, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ хрⷭ҇тꋋ ᲂу҆невѣ́стившасѧ, и҆ жела́нїемъ твои́мъ ᲂу҆ѧзвля́еми, є҆ди́наго сꙋ́щаго возлюби́ша: ро́дъ и҆ ѻ҆те́чество и҆ бога́тство ѡ҆ве́ргше, прибѣжа́тели твоѝ, Ѽ и҆збави́телю бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Ye who walk in the light of the Lord, come, let us hymn the divine gate of the King of kings, Mary...[^298] the pure Mother, truly the Birthgiver of God, as the hope of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Ye who walk in the light of the Lord, come, let us hymn the divine gate of the King of kings, Mary...[^298]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: м[а]т[е]рію чистою б[г]ороди́цю вои́стинну, ꙗ́кѡ оупова́нїе дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* While the instruments of impiety sounded another song, the God-proclaimed harps of piety sang: Bless the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* While the instruments of impiety sounded another song, the God-proclaimed harps of piety sang: Bless the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. їрмо́съ: Нече́стїа ѻрга́ны инꙋ́ю пѣ́снь, бл҃гоче́стїа же бг҃овѣща́ннїи поя́хꙋ гꙋ́сли: бл҃гослови́те дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на, хрⷭ҇та̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Emulating the heavenly ranks, equal to the angels, in all-night standings during vigils they sang: Bless all the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Emulating the heavenly ranks, equal to the angels, in all-night standings during vigils they sang: Bless all the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Нє́бнымъ чинѡ́мъ ревнова́вше равноа́гг҃лни, всено́щными стоя́нїи во бдѣ́нїихъ поя́хꙋ: бл҃гвите всѧ̀ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на, хрⷭ҇та̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Taking up the Cross, whole-souled the martyrs followed Thee, O Master, singing: Bless all the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Taking up the Cross, whole-souled the martyrs followed Thee, O Master, singing: Bless all the works of the Lord, Christ unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ взе́мше, тебѣ̀ влⷣце послѣ́доваша вседꙋ́шнѡ мꙋ́ченицы, пою́ще: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̀ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на, хрⷭ҇та̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having zealously purified body and soul in the Spirit, ye offered yourselves as whole-burnt offerings unto God: scorched in the fire, O fathers, exalting Christ unto all the ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having zealously purified body and soul in the Spirit, ye offered yourselves as whole-burnt offerings unto God: scorched in the fire, O fathers, exalting Christ unto all the ages.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆се́рднѡ, тѣ́ло и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ въ дх҃ѣ ѡ҆чи́стивше, всесожже́нїа бг҃ꙋ принесо́стеся: во ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆пали́вшеся ѻ҆ц҃ы, хрⷭ҇та̀ превознося́ще во вся̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Triadicon:* Let those who blaspheme Thee as being in two hypostases, the Indivisible One, be put to shame, as honoring a quaternity; for we worship Thee, the One of the divine Trinity.[^299]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Triadicon:* Let those who blaspheme Thee as being in two hypostases, the Indivisible One, be put to shame, as honoring a quaternity; for we worship Thee, the One of the divine Trinity.[^299]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇ч: Во двꙋ́хъ ѵ҆поста́сехъ тѧ̀ бы́ти хꙋля́щїи, нераздѣли́маго, да постыдя́тся, я́кѡ четвери́цꙋ чтꙋ́щїи: мы́ бо тебѣ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ бж҃е́ственныя трⷪ҇цы покланя́емся.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* At this the heaven was appalled, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God appeared in the flesh unto men, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of angels and of men magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* At this the heaven was appalled, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God appeared in the flesh unto men, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of angels and of men magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. їрмо́съ: Оу҆жасе́ся ѡ҆ сѐмъ нб҃о, и҆ землѝ оу҆диви́шася концы̀, я́кѡ бг҃ъ яви́ся чл҃кѡмъ пло́тски, и҆ чре́во твоѐ бы́сть простра́ннѣйшее нб҃съ. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ, а҆́гг҃лѡвъ и҆ человѣ́къ чинонача́лїа велича́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Variously the hermits stripped themselves, and having overcome the wiles of the ruler of this world, manfully crushed the barbarian malice like sufferers, having endured their assaults. Therefore also they received double crowns from the righteous Arbiter of the contest.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Variously the hermits stripped themselves, and having overcome the wiles of the ruler of this world, manfully crushed the barbarian malice like sufferers, having endured their assaults. Therefore also they received double crowns from the righteous Arbiter of the contest.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Разли́чнѡ ѡ҆бнажи́шася пꙋ́стницы, и҆ побѣди́вше мїроде́ржца ко́зни, пограми́ша мꙋ́жески я́кѡ страда́льцы, ва́рварское ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїе, си́хъ претерпѣ́вше стремле́нїа. Тѣ́мже и҆ вѣнцы̀ сꙋгꙋ́быя ѿ пра́веднагѡ подвигополо́жника прїя́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Living an ascetic life in dens and caves, O blessed ones, ye were shut up in the dark abyss of a narrow cave, stained with blood, and by the burning of fire, choked bitterly by vapor mingled with smoke, ye were revealed as victorious ones.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Living an ascetic life in dens and caves, O blessed ones, ye were shut up in the dark abyss of a narrow cave, stained with blood, and by the burning of fire, choked bitterly by vapor mingled with smoke, ye were revealed as victorious ones.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Въ верте́пахъ и҆ пеще́рахъ, по́стнически жи́знь прохожда́ще блаже́ннїи, въ пеще́рѣ тѣ́снѣй про́пасти затворе́ни бы́сте несвѣ́тлѣй, ѡ҆багре́ни кровьмѝ, жже́нїемъ же ѻ҆гня̀, и҆́же ѿ ды́ма лю́тѣ па́рою смѣша́емою оу҆давле́ни бы́вше, побѣдоно́сцы яви́стеся.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We sing of the superhuman struggles through which ye suffered against sin, standing against it youthfully as glorious soldiers of Christ; for ye conquered gloriously. And now standing with the ranks of the saints in the highest, be mindful of us.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* We sing of the superhuman struggles through which ye suffered against sin, standing against it youthfully as glorious soldiers of Christ; for ye conquered gloriously. And now standing with the ranks of the saints in the highest, be mindful of us.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ по́двиги па́че є҆стества̀, и҆́миже проти́вꙋ грѣха̀ пострада́сте, ю҆́ношески противоста́вше, я́кѡ хрⷭ҇товы во́инни сла́внїи: и҆́бо побѣди́сте бл҃госла́внѡ. И҆ ны́нѣ предстоѧ́ще съ чи́нми ст҃ы́хъ въ высоча́йшемъ, на́съ помина́йте.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Together with your father and guide, as sincere children, O blessed ones, robed in heaven with the radiance of the Three-hypostatic light: pray for us, your fellow disciples and singers, that common peace be granted to the churches, and salvation to our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Together with your father and guide, as sincere children, O blessed ones, robed in heaven with the radiance of the Three-hypostatic light: pray for us, your fellow disciples and singers, that common peace be granted to the churches, and salvation to our souls.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Съ собо́ю ѻ҆це́мъ и҆ наста́вникомъ, я́кѡ и҆́скренная ча́да блаже́ннїи, на нб҃сѣ́хъ зарѐю ѡ҆дѣ́яни трїѵ҆поста́сною: ѡ҆ на́съ моли́теся, соꙋчени́цѣхъ же и҆ пѣвцѣ́хъ, ми́ръ дарова́ти ѻ҆бщїй цр҃квамъ, и҆ спасенїе дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the cause of heavenly life, and for us who had wretchedly fallen into death, having become the Mother of the Deliverer, thou hast recalled us thou hast recalled us, O all-pure one; and hast accounted us worthy to run again toward our primal fatherland. Therefore, O Mother of God, we unceasingly magnify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:* As the cause of heavenly life, and for us who had wretchedly fallen into death, having become the Mother of the Deliverer, thou hast recalled us...
...thou hast recalled us, O all-pure one; and hast accounted us worthy to run again toward our primal fatherland. Therefore, O Mother of God, we unceasingly magnify thee.

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Прєвѣ́чнꙋющее*, и҆ ника́коже претека́ющее*, возжелѣ́въ бл҃госла́вїе*, сла́вꙋ пренебре́глъ є҆сѝ*, преходѧ́щꙋю и҆ поги́блющꙋю. И҆ крⷭ҇тъ воспрїе́мъ распе́ншемꙋся послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ*, и҆ пло́ть покори́лъ є҆сѝ по́стническими по́двиги*. Сегѡ̀ ра́ди па́мять твоѝ* соверша́емъ Їа́кѡве.
items.english_text: Desiring the everlasting and never-passing good, thou didst despise passing and perishing glory; and taking up the cross, thou didst follow Him Who was crucified, and didst subdue the flesh by ascetic labors. For this cause, we celebrate thy memory, O James.

provenance.verbatim_source: Desiring the everlasting and never-passing good, thou didst despise passing and perishing glory; and taking up the cross, thou didst follow Him Who was crucified, and didst subdue the flesh by ascetic labors. For this cause, we celebrate thy memory, O James.

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мї́рꙋ и҆ страсте́мъ распина́емь Їа́кѡве*, дꙋ́шꙋ соблю́лъ є҆сѝ* нескве́рнꙋ и҆ небла́зненꙋ*, несмѣ́шенꙋ до́лними сꙋеначерта́нми*, и҆ видѣ́нїи та́йными*, воскри́лився къ небе́снымъ. Въ ни́хже твоѐ житїѐ предвозложи́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне*, я́кѡ хрⷭ҇то́въ дрꙋ́гъ и҆́скреннїй*, я́кѡ оу҆го́дникъ вѣ́рнѣйшїй.
items.english_text: Crucified unto the world and the passions, O James, thou didst keep thy soul undefiled and unblemished, unmingled with earthly delineations of vanity, and winged unto heavenly things by mystical visions. Therein thou didst place beforehand thy life, O venerable one, as a sincere friend of Christ, as a most faithful favorite.

provenance.verbatim_source: Crucified unto the world and the passions, O James, thou didst keep thy soul undefiled and unblemished, unmingled with earthly delineations of vanity, and winged unto heavenly things by mystical visions. Therein thou didst place beforehand thy life, O venerable one, as a sincere friend of Christ, as a most faithful favorite.

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Незло́бивъ, цѣ́лъ, мл҃тивъ и҆ братолю́бецъ*, смиреномꙋ́дръ и҆ кро́то́къ*, любвѐ и҆спо́лненъ*, млⷭ҇тынею оу҆кра́шенъ*, терпѣ́нїемъ пожда́теленъ*, вѣ́рою и҆ наде́ждою оу҆краша́емь*, показа́лся є҆сѝ всеприснопа́мятне*: мл҃твами оу҆добря́емь*, и҆ бж҃твенными свѣ́тлостьми свѧще́ннѡ ѡ҆блиста́емь.
items.english_text: Guileless, chaste, merciful, and a lover of the brethren, humble-minded and meek, filled with love, adorned with almsgiving, patient in endurance, adorned with faith and hope, thou wast shown forth, O ever-memorable one, embellished by prayers, and sacredly illumined with divine splendors.

provenance.verbatim_source: Guileless, chaste, merciful, and a lover of the brethren, humble-minded and meek, filled with love, adorned with almsgiving, patient in endurance, adorned with faith and hope, thou wast shown forth, O ever-memorable one, embellished by prayers, and sacredly illumined with divine splendors.

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Скве́рнꙋ ѿмы́й* стра́стнагѡ се́рдца моегѡ̀, бцⷣе всенепоро́чная*, и҆ вся̑ я́звы и҆ гное́нїа сегѡ̀, я́же ѿ грѣха̀*, ѡ҆чи́сти чи́стая*, и҆ оу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ оу҆ставѝ непостоя́нїе: я́кѡ да си́лꙋ твою̀*, и҆ вели́кое застꙋпле́нїе*, велича́ю ѡ҆кая́нный*, и҆ непотрѣ́бный ра́бъ тво́й.
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Wash away the filth of my passionate heart, O all-immaculate Birthgiver of God, and all its wounds and festerings that come from sin, purify, O pure one, and still the instability of my mind: so that I, thy wretched and unprofitable servant, may magnify thy power and great protection.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Wash away the filth of my passionate heart, O all-immaculate Birthgiver of God, and all its wounds and festerings that come from sin, purify, O pure one, and still the instability of my mind: so that I, thy wretched and unprofitable servant, may magnify thy power and great protection.

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: Распна́ема хрⷭ҇та̀ чл҃колю́бца*, ви́дящи пречи́стая*, и҆ ре́бра и҆скопова́ема копїе́мъ*, пла́чꙋщи вопїя́ше*: что̀ сїѐ сн҃е мо́й?* что́ ти безблгода́тнїи людїе возда́ша*, за я́же сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѡ́брая и҆̀мъ, и҆ тщи́шися безча́дствовати мѧ̀ вселюбѣ́знѣйшїй: оу҆дивля́юся бл҃гоꙋтро́бне*, твоему̀ во́льномꙋ распятїю.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for the good things Thou didst do for them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for the good things Thou didst do for them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ Їгна́тїа, гла́съ, в҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. їрмо́съ: Гряди́те
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Come, O ye peoples Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea, and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt, for He hath been glorified.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:* Come, O ye peoples...
...Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea, and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt, for He hath been glorified.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Гряди́те лю́дїе, пои́мъ пѣ́снь хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, раздѣ́льшемꙋ мо́ре, и҆ наста́вльшемꙋ лю́ди, я́же и҆зведѐ и҆з̾ рабо́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ, я́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having received into thy soul the Trinitarian enlightenment, O James, thou didst forsake the dark delusion of the world, and didst obtain otherworldly glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having received into thy soul the Trinitarian enlightenment, O James, thou didst forsake the dark delusion of the world, and didst obtain otherworldly glory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́нїе трⷪ҇ческое Їа́кѡве въ дꙋ́шꙋ прїе́мъ, мї́ра ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ те́мнꙋю пре́лесть: и҆ премї́рнꙋю сла́вꙋ полꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Taking the Cross upon thy shoulder, O venerable one, thou didst follow Him Who was crucified; and having lived the monastic life in all-wisdom, by self-mastery thou didst wither away the passions, O father.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Taking the Cross upon thy shoulder, O venerable one, thou didst follow Him Who was crucified; and having lived the monastic life in all-wisdom, by self-mastery thou didst wither away the passions, O father.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ крⷭ҇тъ на ра́мо взе́мъ, распе́ншемꙋся преподо́бне послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ: и҆ мона́шествовавъ премꙋ́дрѣ, стра̑сти воздержа́нїемъ ѻ҆́че и҆зсуши́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A vessel capable of the gifts of the Spirit wast thou from thine early youth,[^300] and a citizen and heir of Sion on high, O blessed James.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* A vessel capable of the gifts of the Spirit wast thou from thine early youth,[^300] and a citizen and heir of Sion on high, O blessed James.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Вмѣсти́теленъ дарова́нїй дх҃а, ѿ млады́хъ ногте́й твои́хъ сосꙋ́дъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ вы́шнягѡ граждани́нъ Сїѡ́на, и҆ наслѣ́дникъ бл҃же́нне Їа́кѡве. Бг҃оро:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Alone thou didst bear, O Maiden, God Who is uncontainable by all, Who for His goodness became contained in thee: Whom do thou beseech to save those who hymn thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Alone thou didst bear, O Maiden, God Who is uncontainable by all, Who for His goodness became contained in thee: Whom do thou beseech to save those who hymn thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́на бг҃а всѣ́ми сꙋ́ща невмѣсти́ма, тебѣ̀ вмѣ́стна бы́вша за бл҃гость, родила̀ є҆сѝ ѻ҆трокови́це: є҆го́же молѝ спастѝ воспѣва́ющыя тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death, and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who hymn Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death, and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who hymn Thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. їрмо́съ: Оу҆твердѝ на́съ въ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, дре́вомъ оу҆мерщве́й грѣ́хъ, и҆ стра́хъ тво́й всадѝ въ сердца̀ на́съ пою́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fair was thy life, thy speech seasoned with the salt of love, O divinely-wise one, thy heart full of tender compunction: for this cause we bless thee in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Fair was thy life, thy speech seasoned with the salt of love, O divinely-wise one, thy heart full of tender compunction: for this cause we bless thee in faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Житїѐ твоѐ кра́сно, сло́во со́лїю любвѐ бг҃омꙋ́дре растворе́но, се́рдце бл҃гоꙋмиле́нно: сегѡ̀ ра́ди тѧ̀ вѣ́рою оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Venerating the divine icon of Christ Who appeared in the flesh for our sake, thou didst endure persecutions, O father, and perils and afflictions, O all-blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Venerating the divine icon of Christ Who appeared in the flesh for our sake, thou didst endure persecutions, O father, and perils and afflictions, O all-blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇та̀ на́съ ра́ди я́вльшагѡся пло́тїю, бж҃е́ственный почита́я ѻ҆́бразъ, гоне́нїа ѻ҆́че претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ бѣды̀ и҆ скѡ́рби всеблаже́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a pure sacrifice thou didst offer thyself unto the Lord by putting sin to death; and as a lawful hierarch thou didst offer unto Him the bloodless sacrifices.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As a pure sacrifice thou didst offer thyself unto the Lord by putting sin to death; and as a lawful hierarch thou didst offer unto Him the bloodless sacrifices.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Я҆́кѡ же́ртвꙋ чи́стꙋ себеса́маго прине́слъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇ви, оу҆мерщвле́нїемъ грѣха̀: и҆ же́ртвы безкро́вны томꙋ̀, я́кѡ ст҃и́тель зако́ненъ прине́слъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a truly golden censer, and the jar of manna, and the divine mountain, and the most fair palace of God, do we name thee, O Virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* As a truly golden censer, and the jar of manna, and the divine mountain, and the most fair palace of God, do we name thee, O Virgin.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Зла́тꙋ я́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ кади́льницꙋ, и҆ ста́мнꙋ ма́нны, и҆ бж҃твеннꙋю го́рꙋ, и҆ пала́тꙋ прекра́снѣйшꙋю бж҃їю, тѧ̀ дв҃о и҆менꙋ́емъ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily go before" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):* Having forsaken the world, thou didst follow Christ, and manifestly subdue the flesh by self-mastery, O most blessed James; whence thou didst receive the holy anointing of priesthood. And now thou art translated unto the heavenly choirs, praying for all of us who praise thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily go before" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):* Having forsaken the world, thou didst follow Christ, and manifestly subdue the flesh by self-mastery, O most blessed James; whence thou didst receive the holy anointing of priesthood. And now thou art translated unto the heavenly choirs, praying for all of us who praise thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ско́рѡ предварѝ: Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ послѣ́довавъ є҆сѝ мі́ръ ѡ҆ста́вивъ, и҆ пло́ть покори́въ воздержа́нїемъ ꙗ҆́вѣ, преблаже́нне Їа́кѡве. Ѿню́дꙋже свяще́нства пома́занїе ст҃о́е и҆мѣ́лъ є҆сѝ. Ны́нѣ же къ небе́ственнымъ преста́вился є҆сѝ ликѡ́мъ, моля̀ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ восхваля́ющихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Alone having given birth unto the Creator of all, alone having adorned humanity by thy childbirth, O Bride of God: deliver me from the snare of the deceitful enemy; establish me upon the rock of the desires of Christ, diligently praying unto Him Whom thou didst enflesh.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory, both now, Theotokion:* Alone having given birth unto the Creator of all, alone having adorned humanity by thy childbirth, O Bride of God: deliver me from the snare of the deceitful enemy; establish me upon the rock of the desires of Christ, diligently praying unto Him Whom thou didst enflesh.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Є҆ди́на ро́ждшая творца̀ всемꙋ̀, є҆ди́на оу҆кра́сившая чл҃вѣ́чество, ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ бг҃оневѣ́сто: и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ сѣ́ти льсти́вагѡ врага̀, поста́ви мѧ̀ на ка́мени хрⷭ҇то́выхъ хотѣ́нїй, того̀ моля́щи прилѣ́жнѡ, є҆го́же воплоти́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word O Word of God, weeping maternally she said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death? Willing to give life unto the dead, as Thou art compassionate!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:* When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word...
...O Word of God, weeping maternally she said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death? Willing to give life unto the dead, as Thou art compassionate!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: сло́ве бж҃їй, мт҃рски рыда́ющи вѣща́ше: что̀ но́вое и҆ стра́нное сїѐ чꙋ́до сн҃е мо́й? ка́кѡ жи́знь всѣ́хъ вкꙋша́еши сме́рти? ѡ҆живи́ти ме́ртвыя хотя̀, я́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. їрмо́съ: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и, слꙋ́хъ твоегѡ̀ смотре́нїя, и҆ просла́вихъ тѧ̀ є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By all-night supplications having put to death the pleasures of the flesh, thou wast revealed as a heavenly lamp of dispassion, O venerable one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* By all-night supplications having put to death the pleasures of the flesh, thou wast revealed as a heavenly lamp of dispassion, O venerable one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Всено́щными мольба́ми, сла́сти тѣле́сныя оу҆мертви́въ, безстра́стїя яви́лся є҆сѝ свѣти́льникъ, небѣ́сный прпⷣбне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ever washed by streams of tears, O all-blessed one, thou wast shown forth as a pure dwelling of the Holy Spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ever washed by streams of tears, O all-blessed one, thou wast shown forth as a pure dwelling of the Holy Spirit.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сле́зъ тече́ньми всегда̀ ѡ҆мыва́яся пребл҃же́нне, чи́сто прїя́телище яви́лся є҆сѝ ст҃а́гѡ дх҃а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Humble and meek, compassionate and guileless, and chaste hierarch wast thou, O venerable one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Humble and meek, compassionate and guileless, and chaste hierarch wast thou, O venerable one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нъ же и҆ кро́токъ, и҆ сострада́теленъ и҆ неѕло́бивъ, и҆ цѣломꙋ́дръ ст҃и́тель прпⷣбне бы́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unwedded Sovereign Lady, who didst conceive God in thy womb, deliver all from perils and sorrows.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O unwedded Sovereign Lady, who didst conceive God in thy womb, deliver all from perils and sorrows.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ор: Неискꙋсобра́чная влⷣчце, я́же бг҃а во чре́вѣ заче́нши, напа́стей и҆ печа́лей вся̑ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for we know no other God besides Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for we know no other God besides Thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. їрмо́съ: Свѣ́та пода́телю, и҆ вѣкѡ́въ тво́рче гдⷭ҇и, во свѣ́тѣ твои́хъ повелѣ́нїй наста́ви на́съ: ра́звѣ бо тебѐ и҆но́гѡ бг҃а не зна́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Truly, O venerable one, thou didst supernaturally abhor desire for glory that is exalted among men, O father; and thou becamest a lamp shining with the splendor of humility.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Truly, O venerable one, thou didst supernaturally abhor desire for glory that is exalted among men, O father; and thou becamest a lamp shining with the splendor of humility.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́вы жела́нїй вои́стиннꙋ, я́же въ человѣ́цѣхъ высо́кагѡ преподо́бне, преесте́ственнѡ ѻ҆́че возгнуша́лся є҆сѝ: и҆ бы́лъ є҆сѝ свѣти́льникъ, смиреномꙋ́дрїя сїя́я свѣ́тлостїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By much self-mastery and diligent vigilance, O venerable one, in prayer and hardship thou didst seek God, Who hath translated Thee unto the mansions on high.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* By much self-mastery and diligent vigilance, O venerable one, in prayer and hardship thou didst seek God, Who hath translated Thee unto the mansions on high.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Воздержа́нїемъ мно́гимъ, и҆ во бдѣ́нїи прилѣ́жнѣмъ преподо́бне, въ моли́твѣ и҆ въ ѕлострада́нїи взыска́лъ є҆сѝ бг҃а, тѧ̀ къ вы́шнимъ ѻ҆би́телемъ прело́жшаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Keeping thyself free from worldly cares, thou didst stand in all-night prayers, receiving the divine rays with the eye of the soul, O divinely-wise father, hierarch James.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Keeping thyself free from worldly cares, thou didst stand in all-night prayers, receiving the divine rays with the eye of the soul, O divinely-wise father, hierarch James.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆пражня́я себѐ, всено́щными мл҃твами стоя́лъ є҆сѝ: дꙋше́внымъ ѻ҆́комъ бж҃твенныя прїе́мля зарѝ, ѻ҆́че ст҃и́телю бг҃омꙋ́дре Їа́кѡве.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure one, who didst ineffably give birth unto Him Who in the flesh was wounded upon the Cross, as thou art compassionate, heal my heart wounded by the assaults of the crafty one.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O all-pure one, who didst ineffably give birth unto Him Who in the flesh was wounded upon the Cross, as thou art compassionate, heal my heart wounded by the assaults of the crafty one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ород: Оу҆я́збившееся прило́ги лꙋка́вагѡ пречⷭ҇тая, я́кѡ сострада́тельна оу҆врачꙋ́й се́рдце моѐ, сꙋ́щаго на крⷭ҇тѣ́ пло́тїю оу҆я́звеннаго, неизрече́ннѡ ро́ждшая.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Whirling about in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy lovingkindness: Lead me up from corruption, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Whirling about in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy lovingkindness: Lead me up from corruption, O God!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. їрмо́съ: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валя́яся, неизслѣ́днꙋю млⷭ҇рдїя твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ, ѿ тлѝ бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The streams of thy tears, O venerable one, dried up the sea of cruel passions, and obtained consolation in the world beyond for thy precious soul.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The streams of thy tears, O venerable one, dried up the sea of cruel passions, and obtained consolation in the world beyond for thy precious soul.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: То́ки сле́зъ твои́хъ преподо́бне, мо́ре лю́тыхъ страсте́й и҆зсуши́ша, и҆ та́мошнее оу҆тѣше́нїе, честно́й твое́й дꙋшѝ и҆схода́таиша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Guileless, meek, chaste, venerable, gentle, humble-minded and tranquil, and filled with enlightenment wast thou, O all-glorious father.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Guileless, meek, chaste, venerable, gentle, humble-minded and tranquil, and filled with enlightenment wast thou, O all-glorious father.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Незло́бивъ, кро́токъ, цѣ́лъ, преподо́бенъ, сла́докъ, смиренномꙋ́дръ и҆ ти́хъ, и҆ просвѣще́нїя и҆спо́лненъ, пресла́вне ѻ҆́че бы́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Together with the divine shepherds thy memory is glorified, O father, as of a good shepherd, O wise pastor James; for as a venerable one thou didst tend the flock.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Together with the divine shepherds thy memory is glorified, O father, as of a good shepherd, O wise pastor James; for as a venerable one thou didst tend the flock.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Съ бж҃е́ственными па́стыри, па́мять твоя̀ ѻ҆́че спросла́вися, я́коже па́стыря до́брагѡ, па́стырю мꙋ́дре Їа́кѡве, я́кѡ прпⷣбне ста́до оу҆па́слъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who made all things by His will He Who made all things by His will, having willed, dwelt in an unwedded womb: honoring with incorruption those who were diseased with corruption, as He is merciful.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:* He Who made all things by His will...
...He Who made all things by His will, having willed, dwelt in an unwedded womb: honoring with incorruption those who were diseased with corruption, as He is merciful.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бо́лею вся̑ содѣ́лавый, во оу҆тро́бꙋ восхотѣ́въ неискꙋсобра́чнꙋю всели́ся: тлѣ́нїемъ недꙋ́говавшыя, нетлѣ́нїемъ почти́въ я́кѡ милосе́рдъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* When the golden image was worshiped on the plain of Dura, Thy three youths disregarded the godless decree; cast into the midst of the fire, bedewed they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* When the golden image was worshiped on the plain of Dura, Thy three youths disregarded the godless decree; cast into the midst of the fire, bedewed they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. їрмо́съ: О҆́бразꙋ злато́мꙋ на по́лѣ деи́рѣ слꙋжи́мꙋ, трїѐ твоѝ ѻ҆́троцы небрего́ша безбо́жнагѡ велѣ́нїя: посредѣ́ же ѻ҆гня̀ вве́ржени, ѡ҆роша́еми поя́хꙋ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Many persecutions and unremitting trials didst thou endure, conquering the iconoclasts and shining with Orthodoxy, enlightening all who behold thee, and crying, O James: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Many persecutions and unremitting trials didst thou endure, conquering the iconoclasts and shining with Orthodoxy, enlightening all who behold thee, and crying, O James: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Мнѡ́гая гоне́нїя, и҆ неѡсла́бная и҆скꙋше́нїя претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: і҆конобо́рцы побѣжда́я, правосла́вїемъ сїя́я: всѧ̑ зря́щыя просвѣща́я, и҆ взыва́я Їа́кѡве: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pondering the dread coming of Christ, in tender compunction thou didst finish thy whole life, until thou didst find, O blessed one, perfect purification of offenses, and eternal consolation, true enlightenment, and ineffable glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Pondering the dread coming of Christ, in tender compunction thou didst finish thy whole life, until thou didst find, O blessed one, perfect purification of offenses, and eternal consolation, true enlightenment, and ineffable glory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇тово стра́шное прише́ствїе помышля́я, во оу҆миле́нїи всѐ житїѐ сконча́лъ є҆сѝ, до́ндеже ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ блаже́нне, ѡ҆чище́нїе прегрѣше́нїй соверше́нное, и҆ вѣ́чное оу҆тѣше́нїе, просвѣще́нїе и҆́стинное, и҆ сла́вꙋ неизрече́ннꙋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast revealed as a lamb in the meekness of thy soul unto Christ the Shepherd; and guided by Him, thou wast known in deed as a pastor of rational sheep, O father, singing ever with them: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou wast revealed as a lamb in the meekness of thy soul unto Christ the Shepherd; and guided by Him, thou wast known in deed as a pastor of rational sheep, O father, singing ever with them: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Па́стыря хрⷭ҇та̀, въ кро́тости дꙋшѝ яви́лся є҆сѝ а҆́гня, и҆ си́мъ наста́вляемь, па́стырь ѻ҆ве́цъ въ дѣ́лѣ ѻ҆́че слове́сныхъ позна́лся є҆сѝ, съ ни́ми поя̀ всегда̀: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O glorious, unwedded, pure, and blessed one, the correction of the falling, the deliverance of those who sin: save me, a prodigal, save me as I cry unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O glorious, unwedded, pure, and blessed one, the correction of the falling, the deliverance of those who sin: save me, a prodigal, save me as I cry unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: О҆́бо сла́вная, неискꙋсобра́чная чⷭ҇тая благослове́нная, па́дающихъ и҆справле́нїе, согрѣша́ющихъ и҆збавле́нїе, спасѝ мѧ̀ блꙋ́днаго спасѝ, сн҃ꙋ твоемꙋ̀ зовꙋ́ща: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who descended into the fiery furnace to the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew, sing unto God as the Lord, O all ye works, and exalt Him unto all the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who descended into the fiery furnace to the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew, sing unto God as the Lord, O all ye works, and exalt Him unto all the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. їрмо́съ: Въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненнꙋю къ ѻ҆троко́мъ є҆вре́йскимъ снизше́дшаго, и҆ пла́мень въ ро́сꙋ прело́жшаго бг҃а, по́йте дѣла̀ я́кѡ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy most pure mind, enlightened with divine purity, wisely turned away from demonic darkness, the gloom of the passions, O venerable one, crying: Sing, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him unto all the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thy most pure mind, enlightened with divine purity, wisely turned away from demonic darkness, the gloom of the passions, O venerable one, crying: Sing, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him unto all the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, on the 16th Day: The Holy Martyrs Sabinus and Papas*[^255]
items.slavonic_text: Чистѣ́йшїй тво́й оу҆́мъ, чистото́ю бж҃е́ственною просвѣще́нъ, бѣсо́вскїя тмы̀ и҆ мглы̀, страсте́й, разꙋ́мнѡ оу҆клони́ся преподо́бне, зовы́й: по́йте всѧ̀ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
